2.6.10.m: For the win of wealth, may the two partake of the bestowal of wealth; Hotṛ, sacrifice! / The divine vigor-libations, milking, yielding well, / made Indra grow with milk. / The one brought refreshment and vigor; / the other, eating together and drinking together. / Honoring the earlier with the new, / and the new with the ancient, / the two vigor-libations established vigor and desirable wealth / for the instructed sacrificer. / For the win of wealth, may the two partake of the bestowal of wealth; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

2.6.10.s: devā daivyā hotārā | devamindramavardhatām | hatāghaśaṃsāvābhārṣṭāṃ vasu vāryāṇi | yajamānāya śikṣitau | vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja | devīstisrastisro devīḥ | patimindramavardhayan | aspṛkṣadbhāratī divam | rudrairyajñaṃ sarasvatī | iḍā vasumatī gṛhān
2.6.10.d: देवा दैव्या होतारा । देवमिन्द्रमवर्धताम् । हताघशंसावाभार्ष्टां वसु वार्याणि । यजमानाय शिक्षितौ । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज । देवीस्तिस्रस्तिस्रो देवीः । पतिमिन्द्रमवर्धयन् । अस्पृक्षद्भारती दिवम् । रुद्रैर्यज्ञं सरस्वती । इडा वसुमती गृहान्
2.6.10.m: The two divine Hotṛs / made the god Indra grow. / Having slain the evil-speakers, the two brought desirable wealth / for the instructed sacrificer. / For the win of wealth, may the two partake of the bestowal of wealth; Hotṛ, sacrifice! / The three goddesses, the three goddesses, / made their husband Indra grow: / Bhāratī touched heaven, / Sarasvatī the sacrifice with the Rudras, / Iḍā, possessing wealth, the homes.

2.6.10.s: vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | deva indro narāśaṃsaḥ | trivarūthastrivandhuraḥ | devamindramavardhayat | śatena śitipṛṣṭhānāmāhitaḥ | sahasreṇa pravartate | mitrāvaruṇedasya hotramarhataḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ stotram | aśvinā''dhvaryavam | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
2.6.10.d: वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देव इन्द्रो नराशंसः । त्रिवरूथस्त्रिवन्धुरः । देवमिन्द्रमवर्धयत् । शतेन शितिपृष्ठानामाहितः । सहस्रेण प्रवर्तते । मित्रावरुणेदस्य होत्रमर्हतः । बृहस्पतिः स्तोत्रम् । अश्विना'ऽध्वर्यवम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज
2.6.10.m: For the win of wealth, may they partake of the bestowal of wealth; Hotṛ, sacrifice! / The divine Indra Narāśaṃsa, / with three shelters, three chariot-boxes, / made the god Indra grow. / Set with a hundred dark-backed [steeds], / he rolls forward with a thousand. / Mitra and Varuṇa indeed are worthy of his Hotṛ-ship, / Bṛhaspati of the chant, / the Aśvins of the Adhvaryu-ship. / For the win of wealth, may he partake of the bestowal of wealth; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

2.6.10.s: deva indro vanaspatiḥ | hiraṇyaparṇo madhuśākhaḥ supippalaḥ | devamindramavardhayat | divamagreṇāprāt | ā'ntarikṣaṃ pṛthivīmadṛṃhīt | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja | devaṃ barhirvāritīnām | devamindramavardhayat | svāsasthamindreṇāsannam | anyā barhīgṣyabhyabhūt | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja | devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | devamindramavardhayat | sviṣṭaṃ kurvanthsviṣṭakṛt | sviṣṭamadya karotu naḥ | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
2.6.10.d: देव इन्द्रो वनस्पतिः । हिरण्यपर्णो मधुशाखः सुपिप्पलः । देवमिन्द्रमवर्धयत् । दिवमग्रेणाप्रात् । आऽन्तरिक्षं पृथिवीमदृंहीत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज । देवं बर्हिर्वारितीनाम् । देवमिन्द्रमवर्धयत् । स्वासस्थमिन्द्रेणासन्नम् । अन्या बर्हीग्ष्यभ्यभूत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज । देवो अग्निः स्विष्टकृत् । देवमिन्द्रमवर्धयत् । स्विष्टं कुर्वन्थ्स्विष्टकृत् । स्विष्टमद्य करोतु नः । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज
2.6.10.m: The divine Indra, the Lord of the Forest, / golden-leaved, honey-branched, bearing good fruit, / made the god Indra grow. / With his tip he filled heaven; / he made firm the atmosphere and the earth. / For the win of wealth, may he partake of the bestowal of wealth; Hotṛ, sacrifice! / The divine grass of the streams / made the god Indra grow. / Having a good seat, seated with Indra, / it overcame the other grass-strewn layers. / For the win of wealth, may it partake of the bestowal of wealth; Hotṛ, sacrifice! / The divine Agni Sviṣṭakṛt / made the god Indra grow. / Making the sacrifice well offered, Sviṣṭakṛt, / let him make [the sacrifice] well offered for us today. / For the win of wealth, may he partake of the bestowal of wealth; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

2.6.11.s: hotā yakṣathsamidhā'gnimiḍaspade | aśvinendraṃ sarasvatīm | ajo dhūmro na godhūmaiḥ kvalairbheṣajam | madhu śaṣpairna teja indriyam | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣattanūnapāthsarasvatī | avirmeṣo na bheṣajam | pathā madhumatā''bharan | aśvinendrāya vīryam
2.6.11.d: होता यक्षथ्समिधाऽग्निमिडस्पदे । अश्विनेन्द्रं सरस्वतीम् । अजो धूम्रो न गोधूमैः क्वलैर्भेषजम् । मधु शष्पैर्न तेज इन्द्रियम् । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षत्तनूनपाथ्सरस्वती । अविर्मेषो न भेषजम् । पथा मधुमता'ऽभरन् । अश्विनेन्द्राय वीर्यम्
2.6.11.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice with kindling to Agni at the place of Iḍā, / to the Aśvins, to Indra, to Sarasvatī: / the he-goat like smoke, with wheat and jujube-fruit as the medicine, / honey with sprouted grains, fiery energy, power of the senses; / milk, soma with parisrut, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the ghee; Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice: Tanūnapāt, Sarasvatī, / the sheep like a ram as the medicine; / along the honeyed path the Aśvins / brought heroic power to Indra.

2.6.11.s: badarairupavākābhirbheṣajaṃ tokmabhiḥ | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣannarāśaṃsaṃ na nagnahum | patiṃsurāyai bheṣajam | meṣaḥ sarasvatī bhiṣak | ratho na candryaśvinorvapā indrasya vīryam | badarairupavākābhirbheṣajaṃ tokmabhiḥ | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja
2.6.11.d: बदरैरुपवाकाभिर्भेषजं तोक्मभिः । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षन्नराशंसं न नग्नहुम् । पतिंसुरायै भेषजम् । मेषः सरस्वती भिषक् । रथो न चन्द्र्यश्विनोर्वपा इन्द्रस्य वीर्यम् । बदरैरुपवाकाभिर्भेषजं तोक्मभिः । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज
2.6.11.m: With jujube berries and upavāka seeds, with sprouting shoots as the medicine, / milk, soma with parisrut, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the ghee; Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Narāśaṃsa like yeast, / the medicine for the lord of surā; / the ram, Sarasvatī the physician; / shining like a chariot, the omentum of the Aśvins, the heroic power of Indra; / with jujube berries and upavāka seeds, with sprouting shoots as the medicine, / milk, soma with parisrut, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the ghee; Hotṛ, sacrifice!

2.6.11.s: hotā yakṣadiḍeḍita ājuhvānaḥ sarasvatīm | indraṃ balena vardhayann | ṛṣabheṇa gavendriyam | aśvinendrāya vīryam | yavaiḥ karkandhubhiḥ | madhu lājairna māsaram | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣadbarhiḥ suṣṭarīmorṇamradāḥ | bhiṣaṅnāsatyā
2.6.11.d: होता यक्षदिडेडित आजुह्वानः सरस्वतीम् । इन्द्रं बलेन वर्धयन्न् । ऋषभेण गवेन्द्रियम् । अश्विनेन्द्राय वीर्यम् । यवैः कर्कन्धुभिः । मधु लाजैर्न मासरम् । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षद्बर्हिः सुष्टरीमोर्णम्रदाः । भिषङ्नासत्या
2.6.11.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the praised Iḍā, invoking Sarasvatī, / strengthening Indra with power, / with a bull, with a cow, [giving] sensory power, / [and] the two Aśvins [giving] heroic power to Indra; / with barley, with karkandhu berries, / sweet like groats [mingled with] fermented liquor; / milk, soma, filtered wine, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the sacrificial grass, spread wide, soft as wool; / the healer, the two Nāsatyas,

2.6.11.s: bhiṣajā'śvinā'śvā śiśumatī | bhiṣagdhenuḥ sarasvatī | bhiṣagduha indrāya bheṣajam | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣadduro diśaḥ | kavaṣyo na vyacasvatīḥ | aśvibhyāṃ na duro diśaḥ | indro na rodasī dughe | duhe kāmānthsarasvatī
2.6.11.d: भिषजाऽश्विनाऽश्वा शिशुमती । भिषग्धेनुः सरस्वती । भिषग्दुह इन्द्राय भेषजम् । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षद्दुरो दिशः । कवष्यो न व्यचस्वतीः । अश्विभ्यां न दुरो दिशः । इन्द्रो न रोदसी दुघे । दुहे कामान्थ्सरस्वती
2.6.11.m: the two Aśvins as healers, the mare with foal; / the healer, Sarasvatī the milch cow; / the healer yields healing to Indra; / milk, soma, filtered wine, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the doors, the quarters, / wide-opening like portal-valves; / the doors, the quarters, as for the Aśvins; / Indra as the two yielding world-halves; / Sarasvatī yields desires;

2.6.11.s: aśvinendrāya bheṣajam | śukraṃ na jyotirindriyam | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣathsupeśasoṣe naktaṃ divā | aśvinā saṃjānāne | samañjāte sarasvatyā | tviṣimindre na bheṣajam | śyeno na rajasā hṛdā | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu
2.6.11.d: अश्विनेन्द्राय भेषजम् । शुक्रं न ज्योतिरिन्द्रियम् । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षथ्सुपेशसोषे नक्तं दिवा । अश्विना संजानाने । समञ्जाते सरस्वत्या । त्विषिमिन्द्रे न भेषजम् । श्येनो न रजसा हृदा । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु
2.6.11.m: the Aśvins [yield] healing to Indra, / bright light, sensory power; / milk, soma, filtered wine, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the well-adorned Day and Night, by day, / the two Aśvins in accord; / they are anointed together with Sarasvatī, / [bringing] radiance to Indra, as healing; / like a falcon through the middle realm, by heart; / milk, soma, filtered wine, ghee, honey—

2.6.11.s: viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣaddaivyā hotārā bhiṣajā'śvinā | indraṃ na jāgṛvī divā naktaṃ na bheṣajaiḥ | śūṣaṃ sarasvatī bhiṣak | sīsena duha indriyam | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣattisro devīrna bheṣajam | trayastridhātavo'pasaḥ | rūpamindre hiraṇyayam ||
2.6.11.d: वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षद्दैव्या होतारा भिषजाऽश्विना । इन्द्रं न जागृवी दिवा नक्तं न भेषजैः । शूषं सरस्वती भिषक् । सीसेन दुह इन्द्रियम् । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षत्तिस्रो देवीर्न भेषजम् । त्रयस्त्रिधातवोऽपसः । रूपमिन्द्रे हिरण्ययम् ॥
2.6.11.m: may they partake of the butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the two divine Hotṛs, the healing Aśvins; / watchful over Indra, by day and by night, with remedies; / Sarasvatī the vigorous healer, / with lead yields sensory power; / milk, soma, filtered wine, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the three goddesses, as healing, / threefold workers of the three realms, / golden form in Indra;

2.6.11.s: aśvineḍā na bhāratī | vācā sarasvatī | maha indrāya dadhurindriyam | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣattvaṣṭāramindramaśvinā | bhiṣajaṃ na sarasvatīm | ojo na jūtirindriyam | vṛko na rabhaso bhiṣak | yaśaḥ surayā bheṣajam
2.6.11.d: अश्विनेडा न भारती । वाचा सरस्वती । मह इन्द्राय दधुरिन्द्रियम् । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षत्त्वष्टारमिन्द्रमश्विना । भिषजं न सरस्वतीम् । ओजो न जूतिरिन्द्रियम् । वृको न रभसो भिषक् । यशः सुरया भेषजम्
2.6.11.m: the Aśvins, Iḍā, and Bhāratī; / Sarasvatī with speech; / greatness, sensory power have they bestowed on Indra; / milk, soma, filtered wine, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Tvaṣṭṛ, Indra, the Aśvins, / to Sarasvatī as healer; / splendorous might, impulse, sensory power; / fierce like a wolf, the healer; / glory, with liquor, as healing;

2.6.11.s: śriyā na māsaram | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣadvanaspatim | śamitāraṃ śatakratum | bhīmaṃ na manyuṃ rājānaṃ vyāghraṃ namasā'śvinā bhāmam | sarasvatī bhiṣak | indrāya duha indriyam | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja
2.6.11.d: श्रिया न मासरम् । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षद्वनस्पतिम् । शमितारं शतक्रतुम् । भीमं न मन्युं राजानं व्याघ्रं नमसाऽश्विना भामम् । सरस्वती भिषक् । इन्द्राय दुह इन्द्रियम् । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज
2.6.11.m: like fermented liquor with beauty; / milk, soma, filtered wine, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the Lord of the Forest, / the slaughterer of hundredfold resolve, / dread wrath, the king, the tiger; the Aśvins with reverence, Sarasvatī the fierce healer; / she yields sensory power to Indra; / milk, soma, filtered wine, ghee, honey—may they partake of the butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice!

2.6.11.s: hotā yakṣadagniṃ svāhā''jyasya stokānām | svāhā medasāṃ pṛthak | svāhā chāgamaśvibhyām | svāhā meṣaṃ sarasvatyai | svāharṣabhamindrāya siṃhāya sahasendriyam | svāhā'gniṃ na bheṣajam | svāhā somamindriyam | svāhendraṃ sutrāmāṇaṃ savitāraṃ varuṇaṃ bhiṣajāṃ patim | svāhā vanaspatiṃ priyaṃ pātho na bheṣajam | svahā devāṃ ājyapān
2.6.11.d: होता यक्षदग्निं स्वाहा'ऽज्यस्य स्तोकानाम् । स्वाहा मेदसां पृथक् । स्वाहा छागमश्विभ्याम् । स्वाहा मेषं सरस्वत्यै । स्वाहर्षभमिन्द्राय सिंहाय सहसेन्द्रियम् । स्वाहाऽग्निं न भेषजम् । स्वाहा सोममिन्द्रियम् । स्वाहेन्द्रं सुत्रामाणं सवितारं वरुणं भिषजां पतिम् । स्वाहा वनस्पतिं प्रियं पाथो न भेषजम् । स्वहा देवां आज्यपान्
2.6.11.m: May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Agni: Svāhā to the drops of butter! / Svāhā to the fats severally! / Svāhā to the goat for the Aśvins! / Svāhā to the ram for Sarasvatī! / Svāhā to the bull for Indra, the lion, with might, sensory power! / Svāhā to Agni as healing! / Svāhā to Soma, sensory power! / Svāhā to Indra Sutrāman, Savitṛ, Varuṇa the lord of healers! / Svāhā to the Lord of the Forest, the dear resort, as healing! / Svāhā to the butter-drinking gods!

2.6.11.s: svāhā'gniṃ hotrājjuṣāṇo agnirbheṣajam | payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu | viyantvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣadaśvinā sarasvatīmindraṃ sutrāmāṇam | ime somāḥ surāmāṇaḥ | chāgairna meṣairṛṣabhaiḥ sutāḥ | śaṣpairna tokmabhiḥ | lājairmahasvantaḥ | madā māsareṇa pariṣkṛtāḥ | śukrāḥ payasvanto'mṛtāḥ | prasthitā vo madhuścutaḥ | tānaśvinā sarasvatīndraḥ sutrāmā vṛtrahā | juṣantāṃ saumyaṃ madhu | pibantu madantu viyantu somam | hotaryaja
2.6.11.d: स्वाहाऽग्निं होत्राज्जुषाणो अग्निर्भेषजम् । पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु । वियन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षदश्विना सरस्वतीमिन्द्रं सुत्रामाणम् । इमे सोमाः सुरामाणः । छागैर्न मेषैरृषभैः सुताः । शष्पैर्न तोक्मभिः । लाजैर्महस्वन्तः । मदा मासरेण परिष्कृताः । शुक्राः पयस्वन्तोऽमृताः । प्रस्थिता वो मधुश्चुतः । तानश्विना सरस्वतीन्द्रः सुत्रामा वृत्रहा । जुषन्तां सौम्यं मधु । पिबन्तु मदन्तु वियन्तु सोमम् । होतर्यज
2.6.11.m: Svāhā to Agni from the Hotṛ-office, Agni enjoying healing; / milk, soma, filtered wine, ghee, honey— / may they partake of the butter! Hotṛ, sacrifice! / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the Aśvins, Sarasvatī, Indra Sutrāman; / these somas rich in surā, / pressed with goats, rams, and bulls, / with young sprouts and green shoots, / mighty with parched grains, / intoxications adorned with fermented liquor, / clear, milky, immortal, / set forth for you, dripping honey; those may the Aśvins, Sarasvatī, Indra Sutrāman, the slayer of Vṛtra, / enjoy, the soma-honey; / let them drink, revel, partake of soma! / Hotṛ, sacrifice!

2.6.12.s: samiddho agniraśvinā | tapto gharmo virāṭthsutaḥ | duhe dhenuḥ sarasvatī | somaṃ śukramihendriyam | tanūpā bhiṣajā sute | aśvinobhā sarasvatī | madhvā rajāṃsīndriyam | indrāya pathibhirvahān | indrāyenduṃ sarasvatī | narāśaṃsena nagnahuḥ
2.6.12.d: समिद्धो अग्निरश्विना । तप्तो घर्मो विराट्थ्सुतः । दुहे धेनुः सरस्वती । सोमं शुक्रमिहेन्द्रियम् । तनूपा भिषजा सुते । अश्विनोभा सरस्वती । मध्वा रजांसीन्द्रियम् । इन्द्राय पथिभिर्वहान् । इन्द्रायेन्दुं सरस्वती । नराशंसेन नग्नहुः
2.6.12.m: Kindled is Agni, O Aśvins; / heated the Gharma, the wide-shining [soma] is pressed; / Sarasvatī, the milch cow, yields / soma, bright, sensory power here. / Protectors of the body, the two healers, at the pressed [soma], / both Aśvins, and Sarasvatī, / with sweetness, the mid-regions, sensory power / shall convey by the paths to Indra; / to Indra the drop Sarasvatī [brings], / with the Narāśaṃsa the yeast;

2.6.12.s: adhātāmaśvinā madhu | bheṣajaṃ bhiṣajā sute | ājuhvānā sarasvatī | indrāyendriyāṇi vīryam | iḍābhiraśvināviṣam | samūrjaṃ saṃ rayiṃ dadhuḥ | aśvinā namuceḥ sutam | somaṃ śukraṃ parisrutā | sarasvatī tamābharat | barhiṣendrāya pātave
2.6.12.d: अधातामश्विना मधु । भेषजं भिषजा सुते । आजुह्वाना सरस्वती । इन्द्रायेन्द्रियाणि वीर्यम् । इडाभिरश्विनाविषम् । समूर्जं सं रयिं दधुः । अश्विना नमुचेः सुतम् । सोमं शुक्रं परिस्रुता । सरस्वती तमाभरत् । बर्हिषेन्द्राय पातवे
2.6.12.m: the two Aśvins have placed the honey, / healing, the two healers at the pressed [soma]; / Sarasvatī being invoked [has placed] / sensory powers, heroic power for Indra. / With refreshments the Aśvins have placed refreshment, / vigor together, wealth together; / the Aśvins [took] the pressed [soma] of Namuci, / the soma, clear, with filtered wine; / Sarasvatī brought it / by the sacrificial grass for Indra to drink.

2.6.12.s: kavaṣyo na vyacasvatīḥ | aśvibhyāṃ na duro diśaḥ | indro na rodasī dughe | duhe kāmānthsarasvatī | uṣāsā naktamaśvinā | divendraṃ sāyamindriyaiḥ | saṃjānāne supeśasā | samañjāte sarasvatyā | pātaṃ no aśvinā divā | pāhi naktaṃ sarasvati
2.6.12.d: कवष्यो न व्यचस्वतीः । अश्विभ्यां न दुरो दिशः । इन्द्रो न रोदसी दुघे । दुहे कामान्थ्सरस्वती । उषासा नक्तमश्विना । दिवेन्द्रं सायमिन्द्रियैः । संजानाने सुपेशसा । समञ्जाते सरस्वत्या । पातं नो अश्विना दिवा । पाहि नक्तं सरस्वति
2.6.12.m: Wide-opening like portal-valves, / like the doors, the quarters, for the Aśvins; / like Indra, yielding two world-halves; / Sarasvatī yields desires. / Dawn and Night, O Aśvins, / by day Indra, in the evening with sensory powers; / in accord, well-adorned, / they are anointed together with Sarasvatī; protect us, O Aśvins, by day; / protect [us] by night, O Sarasvatī!

2.6.12.s: daivyā hotārā bhiṣajā | pātamindraṃ sacā sute | tisrastredhā sarasvatī | aśvinā bhāratīḍā | tīvraṃ parisrutā somam | indrāya suṣavurmadam | aśvinā bheṣajaṃ madhu | bheṣajaṃ naḥ sarasvatī | indre tvaṣṭā yaśaḥ śriyam | rūpaṃ rūpamadhuḥ sute | ṛtuthendro vanaspatiḥ | śaśamānaḥ parisrutā | kīlālamaśvibhyāṃ madhu | duhe dhenuḥ sarasvatī | gobhirna somamaśvinā | māsareṇa pariṣkṛtā | samadhātāṃ sarasvatyā | svāhendre sutaṃ madhu
2.6.12.d: दैव्या होतारा भिषजा । पातमिन्द्रं सचा सुते । तिस्रस्त्रेधा सरस्वती । अश्विना भारतीडा । तीव्रं परिस्रुता सोमम् । इन्द्राय सुषवुर्मदम् । अश्विना भेषजं मधु । भेषजं नः सरस्वती । इन्द्रे त्वष्टा यशः श्रियम् । रूपं रूपमधुः सुते । ऋतुथेन्द्रो वनस्पतिः । शशमानः परिस्रुता । कीलालमश्विभ्यां मधु । दुहे धेनुः सरस्वती । गोभिर्न सोममश्विना । मासरेण परिष्कृता । समधातां सरस्वत्या । स्वाहेन्द्रे सुतं मधु
2.6.12.m: O divine Hotṛs, healers, / protect Indra together at the pressed [soma]! / The three threefold [goddesses], Sarasvatī, / the Aśvins, Bhāratī, Iḍā, / the pungent soma with filtered wine, / pressed out for Indra exhilaration. / The Aśvins [are] honeyed healing, / healing for us is Sarasvatī; / Tvaṣṭṛ [placed] in Indra glory, prosperity, / every single form they placed at the pressed [soma]; / in due season Indra, the Lord of the Forest, / exerting himself with filtered wine, / sweet draught for the Aśvins / yields Sarasvatī, the milch cow. / As if with cows, soma, O Aśvins, / adorned with fermented liquor, / they set together with Sarasvatī, / Svāhā, honey pressed for Indra.

2.6.13.s: aśvinā havirindriyam | namucerdhiyā sarasvatī | ā śukramāsurādvasu | maghamindrāya jabhrire | yamaśvinā sarasvatī | haviṣendramavardhayan | sa bibheda valaṃ magham | namucāvāsure sacā | tamindraṃ paśavaḥ sacā | aśvinobhā sarasvatī
2.6.13.d: अश्विना हविरिन्द्रियम् । नमुचेर्धिया सरस्वती । आ शुक्रमासुराद्वसु । मघमिन्द्राय जभ्रिरे । यमश्विना सरस्वती । हविषेन्द्रमवर्धयन् । स बिभेद वलं मघम् । नमुचावासुरे सचा । तमिन्द्रं पशवः सचा । अश्विनोभा सरस्वती
2.6.13.m: The Aśvins, the sensory oblation, / through insight Sarasvatī, / took from the asura Namuci / clear goods, bounty for Indra. / Whomever the Aśvins, Sarasvatī, / with the oblation strengthened, Indra, / he split the strong bounty / together in Namuci the asura; / Indra him the cattle together, / both Aśvins, Sarasvatī,

2.6.13.s: dadhānā abhyanūṣata | haviṣā yajñamindriyam | ya indra indriyaṃ dadhuḥ | savitā varuṇo bhagaḥ | sa sutrāmā haviṣpatiḥ | yajamānāya saścata | savitā varuṇo dadhat | yajamānāya dāśuṣe | ādatta namucervasu | sutrāmā balamindriyam
2.6.13.d: दधाना अभ्यनूषत । हविषा यज्ञमिन्द्रियम् । य इन्द्र इन्द्रियं दधुः । सविता वरुणो भगः । स सुत्रामा हविष्पतिः । यजमानाय सश्चत । सविता वरुणो दधत् । यजमानाय दाशुषे । आदत्त नमुचेर्वसु । सुत्रामा बलमिन्द्रियम्
2.6.13.m: holding, have acclaimed; / the sacrifice, sensory power, through the oblation. / Those who placed sensory power in Indra, / Savitṛ, Varuṇa, Bhaga, / he, Sutrāman, lord of the oblation, / let them attend upon the sacrificer. / Savitṛ, Varuṇa giving / to the worshipping sacrificer, / he seized the wealth of Namuci, / Sutrāman, strength, sensory power.

2.6.13.s: varuṇaḥ kṣattramindriyam | bhagena savitā śriyam | sutrāmā yaśasā balam | dadhānā yajñamāśata | aśvinā gobhirindriyam | aśvebhirvīryaṃ balam | haviṣendraṃ sarasvatī | yajamānamavardhayan | tā nāsatyā supeśasā | hiraṇyavartanī narā | sarasvatī haviṣmatī | indra karmasu no'vata | tā bhiṣajā sukarmaṇā | sā sudughā sarasvatī | sa vṛtrahā śatakratuḥ | indrāya dadhurindriyam
2.6.13.d: वरुणः क्षत्त्रमिन्द्रियम् । भगेन सविता श्रियम् । सुत्रामा यशसा बलम् । दधाना यज्ञमाशत । अश्विना गोभिरिन्द्रियम् । अश्वेभिर्वीर्यं बलम् । हविषेन्द्रं सरस्वती । यजमानमवर्धयन् । ता नासत्या सुपेशसा । हिरण्यवर्तनी नरा । सरस्वती हविष्मती । इन्द्र कर्मसु नोऽवत । ता भिषजा सुकर्मणा । सा सुदुघा सरस्वती । स वृत्रहा शतक्रतुः । इन्द्राय दधुरिन्द्रियम्
2.6.13.m:
Varuṇa [established] regal power [and] indriya,
Savitṛ through Bhaga [established] prosperity,
Sutrāman through renown [established] strength;
establishing [these], they attained the sacrifice.
The two Aśvins with cattle [bestowed] indriya,
with horses heroic power [and] strength;
Sarasvatī with the oblation
strengthened Indra, the sacrificer.
Those two Nāsatyas, beautifully adorned,
men traveling on golden paths,
[and] Sarasvatī rich in oblations—
O Indra, protect us in our works!
Those two physicians of good deeds,
that Sarasvatī yielding abundant milk,
that Vṛtra-slayer of a hundredfold will—
they established indriya for Indra.

2.6.14.s: devaṃ barhiḥ sarasvatī | sudevamindre aśvinā | tejo na cakṣurakṣyoḥ | barhiṣā dadhurindriyam | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | devīrdvāro aśvinā | bhiṣajendre sarasvatī | prāṇaṃ na vīryaṃ nasi | dvāro dadhurindriyam | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja
2.6.14.d: देवं बर्हिः सरस्वती । सुदेवमिन्द्रे अश्विना । तेजो न चक्षुरक्ष्योः । बर्हिषा दधुरिन्द्रियम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देवीर्द्वारो अश्विना । भिषजेन्द्रे सरस्वती । प्राणं न वीर्यं नसि । द्वारो दधुरिन्द्रियम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज
2.6.14.m:
The divine sacred grass [and] Sarasvatī,
well-divine in Indra, the two Aśvins,
like fiery energy, the sight in the two eyes,
established indriya through the sacred grass.
For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the gift of wealth; sacrifice!
The divine doors, the two Aśvins,
the two physicians, Sarasvatī in Indra,
like exhalation, the heroic power in the nose,
the doors established indriya.
For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the gift of wealth; sacrifice!

2.6.14.s: devī uṣāsāvaśvinā | bhiṣajendre sarasvatī | balaṃ na vācamāsye | uṣābhyāṃ dadhurindriyam | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | devī joṣṭrī aśvinā | sutrāmendre sarasvatī | śrotraṃ na karṇayoryaśaḥ | joṣṭrībhyāṃ dadhurindriyam | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja
2.6.14.d: देवी उषासावश्विना । भिषजेन्द्रे सरस्वती । बलं न वाचमास्ये । उषाभ्यां दधुरिन्द्रियम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देवी जोष्ट्री अश्विना । सुत्रामेन्द्रे सरस्वती । श्रोत्रं न कर्णयोर्यशः । जोष्ट्रीभ्यां दधुरिन्द्रियम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज
2.6.14.m:
The two divine dawns, the two Aśvins,
the two physicians, Sarasvatī in Indra,
like strength, the speech in the mouth,
through the two dawns established indriya.
For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the gift of wealth; sacrifice!
The two divine caring ladies, the two Aśvins, Sutrāman, Sarasvatī in Indra,
like hearing, the renown in the two ears,
through the two caring ladies established indriya.
For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the gift of wealth; sacrifice!

2.6.14.s: devī ūrjāhutī dughe sudughe | payasendraṃ sarasvatyaśvinā bhiṣajā'vata | śukraṃ na jyotiḥ stanayorāhutī dhatta indriyam | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | devā devānāṃ bhiṣajā | hotārāvindramaśvinā | vaṣaṭkāraiḥ sarasvatī | tviṣiṃ na hṛdaye matim | hotṛbhyāṃ dadhurindriyam | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja
2.6.14.d: देवी ऊर्जाहुती दुघे सुदुघे । पयसेन्द्रं सरस्वत्यश्विना भिषजाऽवत । शुक्रं न ज्योतिः स्तनयोराहुती धत्त इन्द्रियम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देवा देवानां भिषजा । होताराविन्द्रमश्विना । वषट्कारैः सरस्वती । त्विषिं न हृदये मतिम् । होतृभ्यां दधुरिन्द्रियम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज
2.6.14.m:
The two divine vigor-oblations, yielding and yielding abundantly,
with milk, Indra, Sarasvatī, [and] the Aśvins, the two physicians, favored;
like bright light, in the two breasts, may the two oblations establish indriya.
For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the gift of wealth; sacrifice!
The two divine physicians of the gods,
the two Hotṛs, the two Aśvins for Indra,
Sarasvatī with the vaṣaṭ-calls,
like splendor, the thought in the heart,
through the two Hotṛs established indriya.
For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the gift of wealth; sacrifice!

2.6.14.s: devīstisrastisro devīḥ | sarasvatyaśvinā bhāratīḍā | śūṣaṃ na madhye nābhyām | indrāya dadhurindriyam | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | deva indro narāśaṃsaḥ | trivarūthaḥ sarasvatyā'śvibhyāmīyate rathaḥ | reto na rūpamamṛtaṃ janitram | indrāya tvaṣṭā dadhadindriyāṇi | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja
2.6.14.d: देवीस्तिस्रस्तिस्रो देवीः । सरस्वत्यश्विना भारतीडा । शूषं न मध्ये नाभ्याम् । इन्द्राय दधुरिन्द्रियम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देव इन्द्रो नराशंसः । त्रिवरूथः सरस्वत्याऽश्विभ्यामीयते रथः । रेतो न रूपममृतं जनित्रम् । इन्द्राय त्वष्टा दधदिन्द्रियाणि । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज
2.6.14.m:
The three divine, the three goddesses—
Sarasvatī, the two Aśvins, Bhāratī, [and] Iḍā—
like vigor in the center, in the navel,
established indriya for Indra.
For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the gift of wealth; sacrifice!
The divine Indra, Narāśaṃsa;
provided with triple protection, the chariot goes with Sarasvatī [and] the two Aśvins;
like seed, the immortal form, the womb—
Tvaṣṭṛ establishing indriyas for Indra, for the winning of wealth let them partake of the gift of wealth; sacrifice!

2.6.14.s: deva indro vanaspatiḥ | hiraṇyaparṇo aśvibhyām | sarasvatyāḥ supippalaḥ | indrāya pacyate madhu | ojo na jūtimṛṣabho na bhāmam | vanaspatirno dadhadindriyāṇi | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | devaṃ barhirvāritīnām | adhvare stīrṇamaśvibhyām | ūrṇamradāḥ sarasvatyāḥ
2.6.14.d: देव इन्द्रो वनस्पतिः । हिरण्यपर्णो अश्विभ्याम् । सरस्वत्याः सुपिप्पलः । इन्द्राय पच्यते मधु । ओजो न जूतिमृषभो न भामम् । वनस्पतिर्नो दधदिन्द्रियाणि । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देवं बर्हिर्वारितीनाम् । अध्वरे स्तीर्णमश्विभ्याम् । ऊर्णम्रदाः सरस्वत्याः

2.6.14.s: syonamindra te sadaḥ | īśāyai manyuṃ rājānaṃ barhiṣā dadhurindriyam | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | devān yakṣadyathāyatham | hotārāvindramaśvinā | vācā vācaṃ sarasvatīm | agniṃ somaṃ sviṣṭakṛt | sviṣṭa indraḥ sutrāmā savitā varuṇo bhiṣak | iṣṭo devo vanaspatiḥ | sviṣṭā devā ājyapāḥ | iṣṭo agniragninā | hotā hotre sviṣṭakṛt | yaśo na dadhadindriyam | ūrjamapacitiṃ svadhām | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja
2.6.14.d: स्योनमिन्द्र ते सदः । ईशायै मन्युं राजानं बर्हिषा दधुरिन्द्रियम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देवो अग्निः स्विष्टकृत् । देवान् यक्षद्यथायथम् । होताराविन्द्रमश्विना । वाचा वाचं सरस्वतीम् । अग्निं सोमं स्विष्टकृत् । स्विष्ट इन्द्रः सुत्रामा सविता वरुणो भिषक् । इष्टो देवो वनस्पतिः । स्विष्टा देवा आज्यपाः । इष्टो अग्निरग्निना । होता होत्रे स्विष्टकृत् । यशो न दधदिन्द्रियम् । ऊर्जमपचितिं स्वधाम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज

2.6.15.s: agnimadya hotāramavṛṇīta | ayaṃ sutāsutī yajamānaḥ | pacanpaktīḥ | pacanpuroḍāśān | gṛhṇangrahān | badhnannaśvibhyāṃ chāgaṃ sarasvatyā indrāya | badhnanthsarasvatyai meṣamindrāyāśvibhyām | badhnannindrāyarṣabhamaśvibhyāṃ sarasvatyai | sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatirabhavat | aśvibhyāṃ chāgena sarasvatyā indrāya
2.6.15.d: अग्निमद्य होतारमवृणीत । अयं सुतासुती यजमानः । पचन्पक्तीः । पचन्पुरोडाशान् । गृह्णन्ग्रहान् । बध्नन्नश्विभ्यां छागं सरस्वत्या इन्द्राय । बध्नन्थ्सरस्वत्यै मेषमिन्द्रायाश्विभ्याम् । बध्नन्निन्द्रायर्षभमश्विभ्यां सरस्वत्यै । सूपस्था अद्य देवो वनस्पतिरभवत् । अश्विभ्यां छागेन सरस्वत्या इन्द्राय
2.6.15.m:
Agni has this day been chosen as Hotṛ
by this sacrificer who has pressed and not pressed,
cooking the cooked offerings,
cooking the puroḍāśas,
drawing the cups,
binding a goat for the two Aśvins, for Sarasvatī, for Indra,
binding a ram for Sarasvatī, for Indra, for the two Aśvins,
binding a bull for Indra, for the two Aśvins, for Sarasvatī.
Today the divine tree of the forest has provided a good lap
with the goat for the two Aśvins, for Sarasvatī, for Indra;

2.6.15.s: sarasvatyai meṣeṇendrāyāśvibhyām | indrāyarṣabheṇāśvibhyāṃ sarasvatyai | akṣaṃstānmedastaḥ prati pacatā'grabhīṣuḥ | avīvṛdhanta grahaiḥ | apātāmaśvinā sarasvatīndraḥ sutrāmā vṛtrahā | somānthsurāmṇaḥ | upo ukthāmadāḥ śraudvimadā adan | avīvṛdhantāṅgūṣaiḥ | tvāmadyarṣa ārṣeyarṣīṇāṃ napādavṛṇīta | ayaṃ sutāsutī yajamānaḥ | bahubhya āsaṃgatebhyaḥ | eṣa me deveṣu vasuvāryā yakṣyata iti | tā yā devā devadānānyaduḥ | tānyasmā ā ca śāssva | ā ca gurasva | iṣitaśca hotarasi bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ | sūktavākāya sūktā brūhi
2.6.15.d: सरस्वत्यै मेषेणेन्द्रायाश्विभ्याम् । इन्द्रायर्षभेणाश्विभ्यां सरस्वत्यै । अक्षंस्तान्मेदस्तः प्रति पचताऽग्रभीषुः । अवीवृधन्त ग्रहैः । अपातामश्विना सरस्वतीन्द्रः सुत्रामा वृत्रहा । सोमान्थ्सुराम्णः । उपो उक्थामदाः श्रौद्विमदा अदन् । अवीवृधन्ताङ्गूषैः । त्वामद्यर्ष आर्षेयर्षीणां नपादवृणीत । अयं सुतासुती यजमानः । बहुभ्य आसंगतेभ्यः । एष मे देवेषु वसुवार्या यक्ष्यत इति । ता या देवा देवदानान्यदुः । तान्यस्मा आ च शास्स्व । आ च गुरस्व । इषितश्च होतरसि भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः । सूक्तवाकाय सूक्ता ब्रूहि
2.6.15.m:
with the ram for Sarasvatī, for Indra, for the two Aśvins;
with the bull for Indra, for the two Aśvins, for Sarasvatī.
They have eaten them from the fat; they have received their cooked portions;
they have magnified themselves with the cups.
The two Aśvins, Sarasvatī, [and] Indra Sutrāman, the Vṛtra-slayer, have drunk
the somas mixed with surā.
The Ukthas and exhilarating drinks have been attended to; the non-intoxicating drinks have eaten;
they have magnified themselves with shouts of praise.
You today, O sage, descendant of a sage, grandson of sages, has he chosen,
this sacrificer who has pressed and not pressed,
out of many who have assembled,
saying: 'He shall sacrifice for me among the gods for desirable goods.'
Those divine gifts which the gods have given,
those pray for him,
and approve them.
And you, O Hotṛ, are urged, dispatched as a human for speaking auspicious words;
recite the hymns for the recitation of the hymns!

2.6.16.s: uśantastvā havāmaha ā no agne suketunā | tvaṃ soma mahe bhagaṃ tvaṃ soma pracikito manīṣā | tvayā hi naḥ pitaraḥ soma pūrve tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ | barhiṣadaḥ pitara ā'haṃ pitṝn | upahūtāḥ pitaro'gniṣvāttāḥ pitaraḥ | agniṣvāttānṛtumato havāmahe | narāśaṃse somapīthaṃ ya āśuḥ | te no arvantaḥ suhavā bhavantu | śaṃ no bhavantu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade | ye agniṣvāttā ye'nagniṣvāttāḥ
2.6.16.d: उशन्तस्त्वा हवामह आ नो अग्ने सुकेतुना । त्वं सोम महे भगं त्वं सोम प्रचिकितो मनीषा । त्वया हि नः पितरः सोम पूर्वे त्वं सोम पितृभिः संविदानः । बर्हिषदः पितर आऽहं पितॄन् । उपहूताः पितरोऽग्निष्वात्ताः पितरः । अग्निष्वात्तानृतुमतो हवामहे । नराशंसे सोमपीथं य आशुः । ते नो अर्वन्तः सुहवा भवन्तु । शं नो भवन्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे । ये अग्निष्वात्ता येऽनग्निष्वात्ताः

2.6.16.s: aṃhomucaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ | pare'vare'mṛtāso bhavantaḥ | adhibruvantu te avantvasmān | vānyāyai dugdhe juṣamāṇāḥ karambham | udīrāṇā avare pare ca | agniṣvāttā ṛtubhiḥ saṃvidānāḥ | indravanto haviridaṃ juṣantām | yadagne kavyavāhana tvamagna īḍito jātavedaḥ | mātalī kavyaiḥ | ye tātṛpurdevatrā jehamānāḥ | hotrāvṛdhaḥ stomataṣṭāso arkaiḥ | ā'gne yāhi suvidatrebhirarvāṅ | satyaiḥ kavyaiḥ pitṛbhirgharmasadbhiḥ | havyavāhamajaraṃ purupriyam | agniṃ ghṛtena haviṣā saparyan | upāsadaṃ kavyavāhaṃ pitṛṇām | sa naḥ prajāṃ vīravatīṃ samṛṇvatu
2.6.16.d: अंहोमुचः पितरः सोम्यासः । परेऽवरेऽमृतासो भवन्तः । अधिब्रुवन्तु ते अवन्त्वस्मान् । वान्यायै दुग्धे जुषमाणाः करम्भम् । उदीराणा अवरे परे च । अग्निष्वात्ता ऋतुभिः संविदानाः । इन्द्रवन्तो हविरिदं जुषन्ताम् । यदग्ने कव्यवाहन त्वमग्न ईडितो जातवेदः । मातली कव्यैः । ये तातृपुर्देवत्रा जेहमानाः । होत्रावृधः स्तोमतष्टासो अर्कैः । आऽग्ने याहि सुविदत्रेभिरर्वाङ् । सत्यैः कव्यैः पितृभिर्घर्मसद्भिः । हव्यवाहमजरं पुरुप्रियम् । अग्निं घृतेन हविषा सपर्यन् । उपासदं कव्यवाहं पितृणाम् । स नः प्रजां वीरवतीं समृण्वतु

2.6.17.s: hotā yakṣadiḍaspade | samidhānaṃ mahadyaśaḥ | suṣamiddhaṃ vareṇyam | agnimindraṃ vayodhasam | gāyatrīṃ chanda indriyam | tryaviṃ gāṃ vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣacchucivratam | tanūnapātamudbhidam | yaṃ garbhamaditirdadhe
2.6.17.d: होता यक्षदिडस्पदे । समिधानं महद्यशः । सुषमिद्धं वरेण्यम् । अग्निमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । गायत्रीं छन्द इन्द्रियम् । त्र्यविं गां वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षच्छुचिव्रतम् । तनूनपातमुद्भिदम् । यं गर्भमदितिर्दधे
2.6.17.m: Let the Hotṛ sacrifice in the place of sacred food, / kindle the great renown, / well kindled, choice, / Agni, Indra, who bestows youthful vitality, / the gāyatrī meter, power of the senses, / bestowing a eighteen-month-old bovine animal, youthful vitality. / Let him partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to Tanūnapāt of pure vows, / the breakthrough-maker, / whom Aditi bore as an embryo,

2.6.17.s: śucimindraṃ vayodhasam | uṣṇihaṃ chanda indriyam | dityavāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣadīḍenyam | īḍitaṃ vṛtrahantamam | iḍābhirīḍyaṃ sahaḥ | somamindraṃ vayodhasam | anuṣṭubhaṃ chanda indriyam | trivathsaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhat ||
2.6.17.d: शुचिमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । उष्णिहं छन्द इन्द्रियम् । दित्यवाहं गां वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षदीडेन्यम् । ईडितं वृत्रहन्तमम् । इडाभिरीड्यं सहः । सोममिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । अनुष्टुभं छन्द इन्द्रियम् । त्रिवथ्सं गां वयो दधत् ॥
2.6.17.m: pure Indra who bestows youthful vitality, / the uṣṇih meter, power of the senses, / bestowing a two-year-old bovine animal, youthful vitality. / Let him partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to the praiseworthy one, / praised, greatest slayer of Vṛtra, / power to be praised with offerings of sacred food, / Soma, Indra, who bestows youthful vitality, / the anuṣṭubh meter, power of the senses, / bestowing a three-year-old bovine animal, youthful vitality.

2.6.17.s: vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣathsubarhiṣadam | pūṣaṇvantamamartyam | sīdantaṃ barhiṣi priye | amṛtendraṃ vayodhasam | bṛhatīṃ chanda indriyam | pañcāviṃ gāṃ vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣadvyacasvatīḥ | suprāyaṇā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ
2.6.17.d: वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षथ्सुबर्हिषदम् । पूषण्वन्तममर्त्यम् । सीदन्तं बर्हिषि प्रिये । अमृतेन्द्रं वयोधसम् । बृहतीं छन्द इन्द्रियम् । पञ्चाविं गां वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षद्व्यचस्वतीः । सुप्रायणा ऋतावृधः
2.6.17.m: Let him partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to the one seated well on the sacred grass, / accompanied by Pūṣan, immortal, / sitting on the dear sacred grass, / the immortals, to Indra who bestows youthful vitality, / the bṛhatī meter, power of the senses, / bestowing a thirty-month-old bovine animal, youthful vitality. / Let him partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to the spacious ones, / easy to approach, increasers of cosmic order,

2.6.17.s: dvāro devīrhiraṇyayīḥ | brahmāṇa indraṃ vayodhasam | paṅktiṃ chanda ihendriyam | turyavāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣathsupeśase | suśilpe bṛhatī ubhe | naktoṣāsā na darśate | viśvamindraṃ vayodhasam | triṣṭubhaṃ chanda indriyam
2.6.17.d: द्वारो देवीर्हिरण्ययीः । ब्रह्माण इन्द्रं वयोधसम् । पङ्क्तिं छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । तुर्यवाहं गां वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षथ्सुपेशसे । सुशिल्पे बृहती उभे । नक्तोषासा न दर्शते । विश्वमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । त्रिष्टुभं छन्द इन्द्रियम्
2.6.17.m: the divine, golden doors, / Brahman, Indra who bestows youthful vitality, / the paṅkti meter, power of the senses here, / bestowing a four-year-old bovine animal, youthful vitality. / Let them partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to the well-formed, / finely adorned, both lofty ones, / Night and Dawn, splendid to behold, / the All, Indra who bestows youthful vitality, / the triṣṭubh meter, power of the senses,

2.6.17.s: paṣṭhavāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣatpracetasā | devānāmuttamaṃ yaśaḥ | hotārā daivyā kavī | sayujendraṃ vayodhasam | jagatīṃ chanda ihendriyam | anaḍvāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣatpeśasvatīḥ
2.6.17.d: पष्ठवाहं गां वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षत्प्रचेतसा । देवानामुत्तमं यशः । होतारा दैव्या कवी । सयुजेन्द्रं वयोधसम् । जगतीं छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । अनड्वाहं गां वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षत्पेशस्वतीः
2.6.17.m: bestowing a five-year-old bovine animal, youthful vitality. / Let them partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to the two wise ones, / highest renown of the gods, / the two divine Hotṛs, the two sages, / the two companions, Indra who bestows youthful vitality, / the jagatī meter, power of the senses here, / bestowing a draft-ox, youthful vitality. / Let them partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to the adorned,

2.6.17.s: tisro devīrhiraṇyayīḥ | bhāratīrbṛhatīrmahīḥ | patimindraṃ vayodhasam | virājaṃ chanda ihendriyam | dhenuṃ gāṃ na vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣathsuretasam | tvaṣṭāraṃ puṣṭivardhanam | rūpāṇi bibhrataṃ pṛthak | puṣṭimindraṃ vayodhasam
2.6.17.d: तिस्रो देवीर्हिरण्ययीः । भारतीर्बृहतीर्महीः । पतिमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । विराजं छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । धेनुं गां न वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षथ्सुरेतसम् । त्वष्टारं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । रूपाणि बिभ्रतं पृथक् । पुष्टिमिन्द्रं वयोधसम्
2.6.17.m: three divine, golden goddesses, / the Bhāratīs, lofty, great, / the protector, Indra who bestows youthful vitality, / the virāj meter, power of the senses here, / bestowing like a milch cow, youthful vitality. / Let them partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to the one rich in seed, / Tvaṣṭṛ, increaser of nourishment, / bearing distinct forms, / nourishment, Indra who bestows youthful vitality,

2.6.17.s: dvipadaṃ chanda ihendriyam | ukṣāṇaṃ gāṃ na vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣacchatakratum | hiraṇyaparṇamukthinam | raśanāṃ bibhrataṃ vaśim | bhagamindraṃ vayodhasam | kakubhaṃ chanda ihendriyam | vaśāṃ vehataṃ gāṃ na vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja | hotā yakṣathsvāhākṛtīḥ | agniṃ gṛhapatiṃ pṛthak | varuṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ kavim | kṣattramindraṃ vayodhasam | aticchandasaṃ chanda indriyam | bṛhadṛṣabhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhat | vetvājyasya hotaryaja
2.6.17.d: द्विपदं छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । उक्षाणं गां न वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षच्छतक्रतुम् । हिरण्यपर्णमुक्थिनम् । रशनां बिभ्रतं वशिम् । भगमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । ककुभं छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । वशां वेहतं गां न वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज । होता यक्षथ्स्वाहाकृतीः । अग्निं गृहपतिं पृथक् । वरुणं भेषजं कविम् । क्षत्त्रमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । अतिच्छन्दसं छन्द इन्द्रियम् । बृहदृषभं गां वयो दधत् । वेत्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज
2.6.17.m: the two-footed meter, power of the senses here, / bestowing like an ox, youthful vitality. / Let him partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to the one of a hundred resolves, / golden-winged, possessing hymns, / holding the halter, willful, / Bhaga, Indra who bestows youthful vitality, / the kakubh meter, power of the senses here, / bestowing like a barren or miscarrying cow, youthful vitality. / Let him partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Let the Hotṛ sacrifice to the Svāhā-utterances, / Agni, the householder severally, / Varuṇa, the medicine, the sage, / regal power, Indra who bestows youthful vitality, / the aticchandas meter, power of the senses, / bestowing a great bull, youthful vitality. / Let him partake of the clarified butter. Hotṛ, sacrifice!

2.6.18.s: samiddho agniḥ samidhā | suṣamiddho vareṇyaḥ | gāyatrī chanda indriyam | tryavirgaurvayo dadhuḥ | tanūnapācchucivrataḥ | tanūnapācca sarasvatī | uṣṇikchanda indriyam | dityavāḍgaurvayo dadhuḥ | iḍābhiragnirīḍyaḥ | somo devo amartyaḥ
2.6.18.d: समिद्धो अग्निः समिधा । सुषमिद्धो वरेण्यः । गायत्री छन्द इन्द्रियम् । त्र्यविर्गौर्वयो दधुः । तनूनपाच्छुचिव्रतः । तनूनपाच्च सरस्वती । उष्णिक्छन्द इन्द्रियम् । दित्यवाड्गौर्वयो दधुः । इडाभिरग्निरीड्यः । सोमो देवो अमर्त्यः
2.6.18.m: Agni is kindled with kindling, / well kindled, choice; / the gāyatrī meter, power of the senses, / an eighteen-month-old cow—they bestowed youthful vitality. / Tanūnapāt of pure vows, / Tanūnapāt and Sarasvatī; / the uṣṇih meter, power of the senses, / a two-year-old cow—they bestowed youthful vitality. / Agni is to be praised with offerings of sacred food; / the god Soma is immortal;

2.6.18.s: anuṣṭupchanda indriyam | trivathso gaurvayo dadhuḥ | subarhiragniḥ pūṣaṇvān | stīrṇabarhiramartyaḥ | bṛhatī chanda indriyam | pañcāvirgaurvayo dadhuḥ | duro devīrdiśo mahīḥ | brahmā devo bṛhaspatiḥ | paṅktiśchanda ihendriyam | turyavāḍgaurvayo dadhuḥ
2.6.18.d: अनुष्टुप्छन्द इन्द्रियम् । त्रिवथ्सो गौर्वयो दधुः । सुबर्हिरग्निः पूषण्वान् । स्तीर्णबर्हिरमर्त्यः । बृहती छन्द इन्द्रियम् । पञ्चाविर्गौर्वयो दधुः । दुरो देवीर्दिशो महीः । ब्रह्मा देवो बृहस्पतिः । पङ्क्तिश्छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । तुर्यवाड्गौर्वयो दधुः
2.6.18.m: the anuṣṭubh meter, power of the senses, / a three-year-old cow—they bestowed youthful vitality. / Agni on good sacred grass, accompanied by Pūṣan, / on strewn sacred grass, the immortal one; / the bṛhatī meter, power of the senses, / a thirty-month-old cow—they bestowed youthful vitality. / The divine doors, the great directions, / the god Brahman, Bṛhaspati; / the paṅkti meter, power of the senses here, / a four-year-old cow—they bestowed youthful vitality.

2.6.18.s: uṣe yahvī supeśasā | viśve devā amartyāḥ | triṣṭupchanda indriyam | paṣṭhavāḍgaurvayo dadhuḥ | daivyā hotārā bhiṣajā | indreṇa sayujā yujā | jagatī chanda ihendriyam | anaḍvāngaurvayo dadhuḥ | tisra iḍā sarasvatī | bhāratī maruto viśaḥ
2.6.18.d: उषे यह्वी सुपेशसा । विश्वे देवा अमर्त्याः । त्रिष्टुप्छन्द इन्द्रियम् । पष्ठवाड्गौर्वयो दधुः । दैव्या होतारा भिषजा । इन्द्रेण सयुजा युजा । जगती छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । अनड्वान्गौर्वयो दधुः । तिस्र इडा सरस्वती । भारती मरुतो विशः
2.6.18.m: The two young Dawns, well-formed, / all the immortal gods; / the triṣṭubh meter, power of the senses, / a five-year-old cow—they bestowed youthful vitality. / The two divine Hotṛs, the two physicians, / joined with Indra as companion; / the jagatī meter, power of the senses here, / a draft-ox—they bestowed youthful vitality. / The three: Iḍā, Sarasvatī, / Bhāratī, the Maruts, the clans;

2.6.18.s: virāṭ chanda ihendriyam | dhenurgaurna vayo dadhuḥ | tvaṣṭā turīpo adbhutaḥ | indrāgnī puṣṭivardhanā | dvipācchanda ihendriyam | ukṣā gaurna vayo dadhuḥ | śamitā no vanaspatiḥ | savitā prasuvanbhagam | kakucchanda ihendriyam | vaśā vehadgaurna vayo dadhuḥ | svāhā yajñaṃ varuṇaḥ | sukṣatro bheṣajaṃ karat | aticchandāśchanda indriyam | bṛhadṛṣabho gaurvayo dadhuḥ
2.6.18.d: विराट् छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । धेनुर्गौर्न वयो दधुः । त्वष्टा तुरीपो अद्भुतः । इन्द्राग्नी पुष्टिवर्धना । द्विपाच्छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । उक्षा गौर्न वयो दधुः । शमिता नो वनस्पतिः । सविता प्रसुवन्भगम् । ककुच्छन्द इहेन्द्रियम् । वशा वेहद्गौर्न वयो दधुः । स्वाहा यज्ञं वरुणः । सुक्षत्रो भेषजं करत् । अतिच्छन्दाश्छन्द इन्द्रियम् । बृहदृषभो गौर्वयो दधुः
2.6.18.m: the virāj meter, power of the senses here, / like a milch cow—they bestowed youthful vitality. / Tvaṣṭṛ, the seed-giving, wonderful, / Indra and Agni, increasers of nourishment; / the two-footed meter, power of the senses here, / like an ox—they bestowed youthful vitality. / The plant [and tree] is our slaughterer, / Savitṛ impelling Bhaga; / the kakubh meter, power of the senses here, / like a barren or miscarrying cow—they bestowed youthful vitality. / Svāhā, the sacrifice, Varuṇa; / of good regal power, let him make medicine; / the aticchandas meter, power of the senses, / the great bull—they bestowed youthful vitality.

2.6.19.s: vasantenartunā devāḥ | vasavastrivṛtā stutam | rathantareṇa tejasā | havirindre vayo dadhuḥ | grīṣmeṇa devā ṛtunā | rudrāḥ pañcadaśe stutam | bṛhatā yaśasā balam | havirindre vayo dadhuḥ | varṣābhirṛtunā''dityāḥ | stome saptadaśe stutam
2.6.19.d: वसन्तेनर्तुना देवाः । वसवस्त्रिवृता स्तुतम् । रथन्तरेण तेजसा । हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः । ग्रीष्मेण देवा ऋतुना । रुद्राः पञ्चदशे स्तुतम् । बृहता यशसा बलम् । हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः । वर्षाभिरृतुना'ऽदित्याः । स्तोमे सप्तदशे स्तुतम्
2.6.19.m:
With the spring season, the gods, / the Vasus with the trivṛt [stoma], what was praised, / with the Rathantara, with fiery energy, / the oblation, bestowed youthful vitality in Indra. / With the summer season, the gods, / the Rudras with the fifteenfold [stoma], what was praised, / with the Bṛhat, with renown, power, / the oblation, bestowed youthful vitality in Indra. / With the rainy season, the Ādityas, / in the seventeenfold stoma, what was praised,

with the Vairūpa, with the people, with splendorous might, / the oblation, bestowed youthful vitality in Indra. / With the autumn season, the gods, / the Ṛbhus with the twenty-onefold [stoma], what was praised, / with the Vairāja, with prosperity, prosperity, / the oblation, bestowed youthful vitality in Indra. / With the winter season, the gods, / the Maruts with the thrice-ninefold [stoma], what was praised, / with power, the Śakvarī verses, overriding force, / the oblation, bestowed youthful vitality in Indra. / With the cool season, the gods, / in the thirty-threefold [stoma], what was praised as immortal, / with truth, the Revatī verses, regal power, / the oblation, bestowed youthful vitality in Indra.

2.6.19.s: vairūpeṇa viśaujasā | havirindre vayo dadhuḥ | śāradenartunā devāḥ | ekaviṃśa ṛbhavaḥ stutam | vairājena śriyā śriyam | havirindre vayo dadhuḥ | hemantenartunā devāḥ | marutastriṇave stutam | balena śakvarīḥ sahaḥ | havirindre vayo dadhuḥ | śaiśireṇartunā devāḥ | trayastriṃśe'mṛtaṃ stutam | satyena revatīḥ kṣattram | havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
2.6.19.d: वैरूपेण विशौजसा । हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः । शारदेनर्तुना देवाः । एकविंश ऋभवः स्तुतम् । वैराजेन श्रिया श्रियम् । हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः । हेमन्तेनर्तुना देवाः । मरुतस्त्रिणवे स्तुतम् । बलेन शक्वरीः सहः । हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः । शैशिरेणर्तुना देवाः । त्रयस्त्रिंशेऽमृतं स्तुतम् । सत्येन रेवतीः क्षत्त्रम् । हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः

2.6.20.s: devaṃ barhirindraṃ vayodhasam | devaṃ devamavardhayat | gāyatriyā chandasendriyam | teja indre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja | devīrdvāro devamindraṃ vayodhasam | devīrdevamavardhayan | uṣṇihā chandasendriyam | prāṇamindre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja
2.6.20.d: देवं बर्हिरिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । देवं देवमवर्धयत् । गायत्रिया छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । तेज इन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज । देवीर्द्वारो देवमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । देवीर्देवमवर्धयन् । उष्णिहा छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । प्राणमिन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज
2.6.20.m: The divine sacred grass made Indra, the bestower of youthful vitality, the god, thrive; / with the gāyatrī meter, power of the senses, / bestowing fiery energy, youthful vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, let him partake of the treasure-store. Sacrifice! / The divine doors made the god Indra, bestower of youthful vitality, the god, thrive; / with the uṣṇih meter, power of the senses, / bestowing exhalation, youthful vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, let them partake of the treasure-store. Sacrifice!

2.6.20.s: devī devaṃ vayodhasam | uṣe indramavardhatām | anuṣṭubhā chandasendriyam | vācamindre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja | devī joṣṭrī devamindraṃ vayodhasam | devī devamavardhatām | bṛhatyā chandasendriyam | śrotramindre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
2.6.20.d: देवी देवं वयोधसम् । उषे इन्द्रमवर्धताम् । अनुष्टुभा छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । वाचमिन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज । देवी जोष्ट्री देवमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । देवी देवमवर्धताम् । बृहत्या छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । श्रोत्रमिन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज
2.6.20.m: The two divine Dawns made the god, bestower of youthful vitality, / Indra, thrive; / with the anuṣṭubh meter, power of the senses, / bestowing speech, youthful vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, let the two partake of the treasure-store. Sacrifice! / The two divine Welcoming Ones made the god Indra, bestower of youthful vitality, / the two goddesses made the god thrive; / with the bṛhatī meter, power of the senses, / bestowing hearing, youthful vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, let the two partake of the treasure-store. Sacrifice!

2.6.20.s: devī ūrjāhutī devamindraṃ vayodhasam | devī devamavardhatām | paṅktyā chandasendriyam | śukramindre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja | devā daivyā hotārā devamindraṃ vayodhasam | devā devamavardhatām | triṣṭubhā chandasendriyam | tviṣimindre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja
2.6.20.d: देवी ऊर्जाहुती देवमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । देवी देवमवर्धताम् । पङ्क्त्या छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । शुक्रमिन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज । देवा दैव्या होतारा देवमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । देवा देवमवर्धताम् । त्रिष्टुभा छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । त्विषिमिन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज
2.6.20.m: The two divine Offerings of Vigor [strengthened] the divine Indra, the bestower of vigor; / the two goddesses strengthened the god; / with the paṅkti meter, placing the power of the senses, / brightness, [and] vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, may they partake of the treasure; sacrifice! / The two divine Hotṛs [strengthened] the divine Indra, the bestower of vigor; / the two gods strengthened the god; / with the triṣṭubh meter, placing the power of the senses, / brilliancy, [and] vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, may they partake of the treasure; sacrifice!

2.6.20.s: devīstisrastisro devīrvayodhasam | patimindramavardhayan | jagatyā chandasendriyam | balamindre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | devo narāśaṃso devamindraṃ vayodhasam | devo devamavardhayat | virājā chandasendriyam | reta indre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
2.6.20.d: देवीस्तिस्रस्तिस्रो देवीर्वयोधसम् । पतिमिन्द्रमवर्धयन् । जगत्या छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । बलमिन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देवो नराशंसो देवमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । देवो देवमवर्धयत् । विराजा छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । रेत इन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज
2.6.20.m: The three goddesses, the three goddesses [strengthened] Indra the lord, / the bestower of vigor; / with the jagatī meter, placing the power of the senses, / strength, [and] vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, may they partake of the treasure; sacrifice! / The divine Narāśaṃsa [strengthened] the divine Indra, the bestower of vigor; / the god strengthened the god; / with the virāj meter, placing the power of the senses, / seed, [and] vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, may he partake of the treasure; sacrifice!

2.6.20.s: devo vanaspatirdevamindraṃ vayodhasam | devo devamavardhayat | dvipadā chandasendriyam | bhagamindre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja | devaṃ barhirvāritīnāṃ devamindraṃ vayodhasam | devo devamavardhayat | kakubhā chandasendriyam | yaśa indre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja | devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛddevamindraṃ vayodhasam | devo devamavardhayat | aticchandasā chandasendriyam | kṣattramindre vayo dadhat | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja
2.6.20.d: देवो वनस्पतिर्देवमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । देवो देवमवर्धयत् । द्विपदा छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । भगमिन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज । देवं बर्हिर्वारितीनां देवमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । देवो देवमवर्धयत् । ककुभा छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । यश इन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज । देवो अग्निः स्विष्टकृद्देवमिन्द्रं वयोधसम् । देवो देवमवर्धयत् । अतिच्छन्दसा छन्दसेन्द्रियम् । क्षत्त्रमिन्द्रे वयो दधत् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज
2.6.20.m: The divine Lord of the Forest [strengthened] the divine Indra, the bestower of vigor; / the god strengthened the god; / with the two-footed meter, placing the power of the senses, / good fortune, [and] vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, may he partake of the treasure; sacrifice! / The divine sacrificial grass of the streams [strengthened] the divine Indra, the bestower of vigor; / the god strengthened the god; / with the kakubh meter, placing the power of the senses, / fame, [and] vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, may he partake of the treasure; sacrifice! / The divine Agni Sviṣṭakṛt [strengthened] the divine Indra, the bestower of vigor; / the god strengthened the god; / with the atichandas meter, placing the power of the senses, / regal power, [and] vitality in Indra. / For the win of wealth, may he partake of the treasure; sacrifice!

2.7.1.s: trivṛthstomo bhavati | brahmavarcasaṃ vai trivṛt | brahmavarcasamevāvarundhe | agniṣṭomaḥ somo bhavati | brahmavarcasaṃ vā agniṣṭomaḥ | brahmavarcasamevāvarundhe | rathaṃtaraṃ sāma bhavati | brahmavarcasaṃ vai rathaṃtaram | brahmavarcasamevāvarundhe | parisrajī hotā bhavati
2.7.1.d: त्रिवृथ्स्तोमो भवति । ब्रह्मवर्चसं वै त्रिवृत् । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवावरुन्धे । अग्निष्टोमः सोमो भवति । ब्रह्मवर्चसं वा अग्निष्टोमः । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवावरुन्धे । रथंतरं साम भवति । ब्रह्मवर्चसं वै रथंतरम् । ब्रह्मवर्चसमेवावरुन्धे । परिस्रजी होता भवति
2.7.1.m: There is a ninefold chant. / The ninefold [chant] is indeed spiritual preeminence; / he secures spiritual preeminence. / The soma [sacrifice] is an agniṣṭoma. / The agniṣṭoma is indeed spiritual preeminence; / he secures spiritual preeminence. / The sāman is the rathaṃtara. / The rathaṃtara is indeed spiritual preeminence; / he secures spiritual preeminence. / The Hotṛ wears a garland.

2.7.1.s: aruṇo mirmirastriśukraḥ | etadvai brahmavarcasasya rūpam | rūpeṇaiva brahmavarcasamavarundhe | bṛhaspatirakāmayata devānāṃ purodhāṃ gaccheyamiti | sa etaṃ bṛhaspatisavamapaśyat | tamāharat | tenāyajata | tato vai sa devānāṃ purodhāmagacchat | yaḥ purodhākāmaḥ syāt | sa bṛhaspatisavena yajeta
2.7.1.d: अरुणो मिर्मिरस्त्रिशुक्रः । एतद्वै ब्रह्मवर्चसस्य रूपम् । रूपेणैव ब्रह्मवर्चसमवरुन्धे । बृहस्पतिरकामयत देवानां पुरोधां गच्छेयमिति । स एतं बृहस्पतिसवमपश्यत् । तमाहरत् । तेनायजत । ततो वै स देवानां पुरोधामगच्छत् । यः पुरोधाकामः स्यात् । स बृहस्पतिसवेन यजेत
2.7.1.m: Reddish, blinking, thrice-bright: / this is indeed the form of spiritual preeminence; / by its form he secures spiritual preeminence. / Bṛhaspati desired: 'May I attain the domestic chaplainship of the gods.' / He saw this Bṛhaspatisava. / He took it. / He sacrificed with it. / Thereupon he attained the domestic chaplainship of the gods. / One who desires domestic chaplainship / should sacrifice with the Bṛhaspatisava.

2.7.1.s: purodhāmeva gacchati | tasya prātaḥsavane sanneṣu nārāśaṃseṣu | ekādaśa dakṣiṇā nīyante | ekādaśa mādhyaṃdine savane sanneṣu nārāśaṃseṣu | ekādaśa tṛtīyasavane sanneṣu nārāśaṃseṣu | trayastriṃśathsaṃpadyante | trayastriṃśadvai devatāḥ | devatā evāvarundhe | aśvaścatustriṃśaḥ | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ
2.7.1.d: पुरोधामेव गच्छति । तस्य प्रातःसवने सन्नेषु नाराशंसेषु । एकादश दक्षिणा नीयन्ते । एकादश माध्यंदिने सवने सन्नेषु नाराशंसेषु । एकादश तृतीयसवने सन्नेषु नाराशंसेषु । त्रयस्त्रिंशथ्संपद्यन्ते । त्रयस्त्रिंशद्वै देवताः । देवता एवावरुन्धे । अश्वश्चतुस्त्रिंशः । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः
2.7.1.m: He attains domestic chaplainship. / At its morning pressing, when the nārāśaṃsa [cups] are set down, / eleven sacrificial gifts are led forward; / eleven at the midday pressing, when the nārāśaṃsa [cups] are set down; / eleven at the third pressing, when the nārāśaṃsa [cups] are set down. / They amount to thirty-three. / The deities are thirty-three; / he secures the deities. / A horse is the thirty-fourth. / The horse belongs to Prajāpati.

2.7.1.s: prajāpatiścatustriṃśo devatānām | yāvatīreva devatāḥ | tā evāvarundhe | kṛṣṇājine'bhiṣiñcati | brahmaṇo vā etadrūpam | yatkṛṣṇājinam | brahmavarcasenaivainaṃ samardhayati | ājyenābhiṣiñcati | tejo vā ājyam | teja evāsmindadhāti
2.7.1.d: प्रजापतिश्चतुस्त्रिंशो देवतानाम् । यावतीरेव देवताः । ता एवावरुन्धे । कृष्णाजिनेऽभिषिञ्चति । ब्रह्मणो वा एतद्रूपम् । यत्कृष्णाजिनम् । ब्रह्मवर्चसेनैवैनं समर्धयति । आज्येनाभिषिञ्चति । तेजो वा आज्यम् । तेज एवास्मिन्दधाति
2.7.1.m: Prajāpati is the thirty-fourth of the deities. / As many as are the deities, / those he secures. / He sprinkles [him] upon a black-antelope skin. / This is indeed the form of brahman, / namely, the black-antelope skin; / he endows him with spiritual preeminence. / He sprinkles [him] with clarified butter. / Clarified butter is fiery energy; / he places fiery energy in him.

2.7.2.s: yadāgneyo bhavati | agnimukhā hyṛddhiḥ | atha yatpauṣṇaḥ | puṣṭirvai pūṣā | puṣṭirvaiśyasya | puṣṭimevāvarundhe | prasavāya sāvitraḥ | atha yattvāṣṭraḥ | tvaṣṭā hi rūpāṇi vikaroti | nirvaruṇatvāya vāruṇaḥ
2.7.2.d: यदाग्नेयो भवति । अग्निमुखा ह्यृद्धिः । अथ यत्पौष्णः । पुष्टिर्वै पूषा । पुष्टिर्वैश्यस्य । पुष्टिमेवावरुन्धे । प्रसवाय सावित्रः । अथ यत्त्वाष्ट्रः । त्वष्टा हि रूपाणि विकरोति । निर्वरुणत्वाय वारुणः
2.7.2.m: That there is [an oblation] to Agni: / for success has Agni at its head. / Then that there is [one] to Pūṣan: / Pūṣan is nourishment; / nourishment belongs to the Vaiśya; / he secures nourishment. / [The oblation] to Savitṛ is for impulsion. / Then that there is [one] to Tvaṣṭṛ: / Tvaṣṭṛ fashions forms. / [The oblation] to Varuṇa is for freedom from Varuṇa's [fetters].

2.7.2.s: atho ya eva kaśca santhsūyate | sa hi vāruṇaḥ | atha yadvaiśvadevaḥ | vaiśvadevo hi vaiśyaḥ | atha yanmārutaḥ | māruto hi vaiśyaḥ | saptaitāni havīṃṣi bhavanti | sapta gaṇā vai marutaḥ | pṛśniḥ paṣṭhauhī mārutyālabhyate | viḍvai marutaḥ | viśa evaitanmadhyato'bhiṣicyate | tasmādvā eṣa viśaḥ priyaḥ | viśo hi madhyato'bhiṣicyate | ṛṣabhacarme'dhyabhiṣiñcati | sa hi prajanayitā | dadhnā'bhiṣiñcati | ūrgvā annādyaṃ dadhi | ūrjaivainamannādyena samardhayati
2.7.2.d: अथो य एव कश्च सन्थ्सूयते । स हि वारुणः । अथ यद्वैश्वदेवः । वैश्वदेवो हि वैश्यः । अथ यन्मारुतः । मारुतो हि वैश्यः । सप्तैतानि हवींषि भवन्ति । सप्त गणा वै मरुतः । पृश्निः पष्ठौही मारुत्यालभ्यते । विड्वै मरुतः । विश एवैतन्मध्यतोऽभिषिच्यते । तस्माद्वा एष विशः प्रियः । विशो हि मध्यतोऽभिषिच्यते । ऋषभचर्मेऽध्यभिषिञ्चति । स हि प्रजनयिता । दध्नाऽभिषिञ्चति । ऊर्ग्वा अन्नाद्यं दधि । ऊर्जैवैनमन्नाद्येन समर्धयति
2.7.2.m: Moreover, whosoever is consecrated / belongs to Varuṇa. / Then that there is [one] to the All-gods: / the Vaiśya belongs to the All-gods. / Then that there is [one] to the Maruts: / the Vaiśya belongs to the Maruts. / These offerings are seven. / The Maruts are seven troops. / A speckled, six-year-old cow is seized for the Maruts. / The people are the Maruts; / from the midst of the people he is consecrated. / Therefore he is dear to the people, / for he is consecrated from the midst of the people. / He sprinkles him upon a bull's hide; / for [the bull] is a procreator. / He sprinkles him with curd. / Curd is vigor and edible food; / with vigor and edible food he endows him.

2.7.3.s: yadāgneyo bhavati | āgneyo vai brāhmaṇaḥ | atha yathsaumyaḥ | saumyo hi brāhmaṇaḥ | prasavāyaiva sāvitraḥ | atha yadbārhaspatyaḥ | etadvai brāhmaṇasya vākpatīyam | atha yadagnīṣomīyaḥ | āgneyo vai brāhmaṇaḥ | tau yadā saṃgacchete
2.7.3.d: यदाग्नेयो भवति । आग्नेयो वै ब्राह्मणः । अथ यथ्सौम्यः । सौम्यो हि ब्राह्मणः । प्रसवायैव सावित्रः । अथ यद्बार्हस्पत्यः । एतद्वै ब्राह्मणस्य वाक्पतीयम् । अथ यदग्नीषोमीयः । आग्नेयो वै ब्राह्मणः । तौ यदा संगच्छेते
2.7.3.m: That there is [an oblation] to Agni: / the Brahmin belongs to Agni. / Then that there is [one] to Soma: / the Brahmin belongs to Soma. / [The oblation] to Savitṛ is for impulsion. / Then that there is [one] to Bṛhaspati: / this is the Brahmin's mastery of speech. / Then that there is [one] to Agni and Soma: / the Brahmin belongs to Agni; / when these two come together,

2.7.3.s: atha vīryāvattaro bhavati | atha yathsārasvataḥ | etaddhi pratyakṣaṃ brāhmaṇasya vākpatīyam | nirvaruṇatvāyaiva vāruṇaḥ | atho ya eva kaśca santhsūyate | sa hi vāruṇaḥ | atha yaddyāvāpṛthivyaḥ | indro vṛtrāya vajramudayacchat | taṃ dyāvāpṛthivī nānvamanyetām | tametenaiva bhāgadheyenānvamanyetām
2.7.3.d: अथ वीर्यावत्तरो भवति । अथ यथ्सारस्वतः । एतद्धि प्रत्यक्षं ब्राह्मणस्य वाक्पतीयम् । निर्वरुणत्वायैव वारुणः । अथो य एव कश्च सन्थ्सूयते । स हि वारुणः । अथ यद्द्यावापृथिव्यः । इन्द्रो वृत्राय वज्रमुदयच्छत् । तं द्यावापृथिवी नान्वमन्येताम् । तमेतेनैव भागधेयेनान्वमन्येताम्
2.7.3.m: then he becomes more endowed with heroic power. / Then that there is [one] to Sarasvatī: / this visibly is the Brahmin's mastery of speech. / [The oblation] to Varuṇa is for freedom from Varuṇa's [fetters]. / Moreover, whosoever is consecrated / belongs to Varuṇa. / Then that there is [one] to Heaven and Earth: / Indra raised his thunderbolt against Vṛtra; / Heaven and Earth did not assent to it for him; / by this very sacrificial share they assented to it for him.

2.7.3.s: vajrasya vā eṣo'numānāya | anumatavajraḥ sūyātā iti | aṣṭāvetāni havīṃṣi bhavanti | aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī | gāyatrī brahmavarcasam | gāyatriyaiva brahmavarcasamavarundhe | hiraṇyena ghṛtamutpunāti | tejasa eva ruce | kṛṣṇājine'bhiṣiñcati | brahmaṇo vā etadṛkhsāmayo rūpam | yatkṛṣṇājinam | brahmannevainamṛkhsāmayoradhyabhiṣiñcati | ghṛtenābhiṣiñcati | tathā vīryāvattaro bhavati
2.7.3.d: वज्रस्य वा एषोऽनुमानाय । अनुमतवज्रः सूयाता इति । अष्टावेतानि हवींषि भवन्ति । अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री । गायत्री ब्रह्मवर्चसम् । गायत्रियैव ब्रह्मवर्चसमवरुन्धे । हिरण्येन घृतमुत्पुनाति । तेजस एव रुचे । कृष्णाजिनेऽभिषिञ्चति । ब्रह्मणो वा एतदृख्सामयो रूपम् । यत्कृष्णाजिनम् । ब्रह्मन्नेवैनमृख्सामयोरध्यभिषिञ्चति । घृतेनाभिषिञ्चति । तथा वीर्यावत्तरो भवति
2.7.3.m: This is for the approval of the thunderbolt, / so that he may be consecrated with an approved thunderbolt. / These offerings are eight. / The gāyatrī has eight syllables; / the gāyatrī is spiritual preeminence; / by the gāyatrī he secures spiritual preeminence. / He purifies the clarified butter with gold, / for fiery energy, for luster. / He sprinkles [him] upon a black-antelope skin. / This is the form of brahman, of Ṛg and Sāman, / namely, the black-antelope skin; / in brahman, in the Ṛg and Sāman, he sprinkles him. / He sprinkles [him] with clarified butter; / thus he becomes more endowed with heroic power.

2.7.4.s: na vai somena somasya savo'sti | hato hyeṣaḥ | abhiṣuto hyeṣaḥ | na hi hataḥ sūyate | saumīṃ sūtavaśāmālabhate | somo vai retodhāḥ | reta eva taddadhāti | saumyarcā'bhiṣiñcati | retodhā hyeṣā | retaḥ somaḥ | reta evāsmindadhāti | yatkiṃca rājasūyamṛte somam | tathsarvaṃ bhavati | aṣāḍhaṃ yuthsu pṛtanāsu paprim | suvarṣāmapsvāṃ vṛjanasya gopām | bhareṣujāṃ sukṣitiṃ suśravasam | jayantaṃ tvāmanu madema soma
2.7.4.d: न वै सोमेन सोमस्य सवोऽस्ति । हतो ह्येषः । अभिषुतो ह्येषः । न हि हतः सूयते । सौमीं सूतवशामालभते । सोमो वै रेतोधाः । रेत एव तद्दधाति । सौम्यर्चाऽभिषिञ्चति । रेतोधा ह्येषा । रेतः सोमः । रेत एवास्मिन्दधाति । यत्किंच राजसूयमृते सोमम् । तथ्सर्वं भवति । अषाढं युथ्सु पृतनासु पप्रिम् । सुवर्षामप्स्वां वृजनस्य गोपाम् । भरेषुजां सुक्षितिं सुश्रवसम् । जयन्तं त्वामनु मदेम सोम
2.7.4.m: There is no consecration of soma with soma; / for it is slain, / for it is pressed; / for what is slain is not consecrated. / He seizes a barren cow that has calved for Soma. / Soma is the placer of seed; / he places seed [in him]. / He sprinkles [him] with a verse addressed to Soma; / for it is the placer of seed; / Soma is seed; / he places seed in him. / Whatever [there is] of the Rājasūya except Soma, / all that takes place. / 'Unconquered in battles, savior in conflicts, / heaven-winning, water-winning, guardian of the clan, / born in battles, good dwelling, renowned, / victorious—following you, O Soma, may we rejoice!'

2.7.5.s: yo vai somena sūyate | sa devasavaḥ | yaḥ paśunā sūyate | sa devasavaḥ | ya iṣṭyā sūyate | sa manuṣyasavaḥ | etaṃ vai pṛthaye devāḥ prāyacchan | tato vai so'pyāraṇyānāṃ paśūnāmasūyata | yāvatīḥ kiyatīśca prajā vācaṃ vadanti | tāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ sūyate ||
2.7.5.d: यो वै सोमेन सूयते । स देवसवः । यः पशुना सूयते । स देवसवः । य इष्ट्या सूयते । स मनुष्यसवः । एतं वै पृथये देवाः प्रायच्छन् । ततो वै सोऽप्यारण्यानां पशूनामसूयत । यावतीः कियतीश्च प्रजा वाचं वदन्ति । तासां सर्वासां सूयते ॥
2.7.5.m: The one who is consecrated with soma, / that is the divine consecration. / The one who is consecrated with an animal, / that is the divine consecration. / The one who is consecrated with an iṣṭi, / that is the human consecration. / This [consecration] indeed the gods gave to Pṛthi; / thence indeed he was consecrated even over wild animals. / As many beings as speak speech, / over all of them is he consecrated

2.7.5.s: ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | nārāśaṃsyarcā'bhiṣiñcati | manuṣyā vai narāśaṃsaḥ | nihnutya vāvai tat | athābhiṣiñcati | yatkiṃca rājasūyamanuttara vedīkam | tathsarvaṃ bhavati | ye me pañcāśataṃ daduḥ | aśvānāṃ sadhastutiḥ | dyumadagne mahi śravaḥ | bṛhatkṛdhi maghonām | nṛvadamṛta nṛṇām
2.7.5.d: य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । नाराशंस्यर्चाऽभिषिञ्चति । मनुष्या वै नराशंसः । निह्नुत्य वावै तत् । अथाभिषिञ्चति । यत्किंच राजसूयमनुत्तर वेदीकम् । तथ्सर्वं भवति । ये मे पञ्चाशतं ददुः । अश्वानां सधस्तुतिः । द्युमदग्ने महि श्रवः । बृहत्कृधि मघोनाम् । नृवदमृत नृणाम्
2.7.5.m: who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus. / He sprinkles him with a verse praising men. / Men indeed are praised of men. / Having made an atonement indeed, / he then sprinkles him. / Whatever rite there is of the rājasūya without a high altar, / all that is performed. / “They who gave me fifty / horses in joint praise, / brilliant, O Agni, great renown, / lofty, make for the generous patrons, / heroic, O immortal, for men.”

2.7.6.s: eṣa gosavaḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśa ukthyo bṛhathsāmā | pavamāne kaṇvarathantaraṃ bhavati | yo vai vājapeyaḥ | sa samrāṭthsavaḥ | yo rājasūyaḥ | sa varuṇasavaḥ | prajāpatiḥ svārājyaṃ parameṣṭhī | svārājyaṃ gaureva | gauriva bhavati
2.7.6.d: एष गोसवः । षट्त्रिंश उक्थ्यो बृहथ्सामा । पवमाने कण्वरथन्तरं भवति । यो वै वाजपेयः । स सम्राट्थ्सवः । यो राजसूयः । स वरुणसवः । प्रजापतिः स्वाराज्यं परमेष्ठी । स्वाराज्यं गौरेव । गौरिव भवति
2.7.6.m: This is the cow-consecration; / it is a thirty-six-verse ukthya having the Bṛhat-sāman. / At the pavamāna-laud the Kaṇvarathaṃtara is used. / That which is the Vājapeya, / that is the emperor's consecration. / That which is the rājasūya, / that is Varuṇa's consecration. / Prajāpati Parameṣṭhin is autonomous rule; / autonomous rule is indeed the cow. / Like a cow does he become

2.7.6.s: ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | ubhe bṛhadrathaṃtare bhavataḥ | taddhi svārājyam | ayutaṃ dakṣiṇāḥ | taddhi svārājyam | pratidhuṣā'bhiṣiñcati | taddhi svārājyam | anuddhate vedyai dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya bṛhatastotraṃ pratyabhiṣiñcati | iyaṃ vāva rathaṃtaram |
2.7.6.d: य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । उभे बृहद्रथंतरे भवतः । तद्धि स्वाराज्यम् । अयुतं दक्षिणाः । तद्धि स्वाराज्यम् । प्रतिधुषाऽभिषिञ्चति । तद्धि स्वाराज्यम् । अनुद्धते वेद्यै दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्य बृहतस्तोत्रं प्रत्यभिषिञ्चति । इयं वाव रथंतरम् ।
2.7.6.m: who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus. / Both the Bṛhat and the Rathaṃtara are used, / for that is autonomous rule. / Ten thousand are the sacrificial gifts, / for that is autonomous rule. / He sprinkles him with fresh milk drawn right from the udder, / for that is autonomous rule. / On an unraised [ground] of the altar, south of the Āhavanīya, facing the laud of the Bṛhat, he sprinkles him. / This [earth] indeed is the Rathaṃtara;

2.7.6.s: asau bṛhat | anayorevainamanantarhitamabhiṣiñcati | paśustomo vā eṣaḥ | tena gosavaḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśaḥ sarvaḥ | revajjātaḥ sahasā vṛddhaḥ | kṣatrāṇāṃ kṣattrabhṛttamo vayodhāḥ | mahānmahitve tastabhānaḥ | kṣattre rāṣṭre ca jāgṛhi | prajāpatestvā parameṣṭhinaḥ svārājyenābhiṣiñcāmītyāha | svārājyamevainaṃ gamayati
2.7.6.d: असौ बृहत् । अनयोरेवैनमनन्तर्हितमभिषिञ्चति । पशुस्तोमो वा एषः । तेन गोसवः । षट्त्रिंशः सर्वः । रेवज्जातः सहसा वृद्धः । क्षत्राणां क्षत्त्रभृत्तमो वयोधाः । महान्महित्वे तस्तभानः । क्षत्त्रे राष्ट्रे च जागृहि । प्रजापतेस्त्वा परमेष्ठिनः स्वाराज्येनाभिषिञ्चामीत्याह । स्वाराज्यमेवैनं गमयति
2.7.6.m: that [sky] is the Bṛhat. / Between these two, uninterrupted, he sprinkles him. / An animal praise-song indeed is this; / therefore it is the cow-consecration. / The thirty-six-verse [rite] is complete. / “Richly born, grown by might, / the best bearer of regal power among regal powers, bestower of youthful vigor, / great, standing firm in greatness, / be wakeful in regal power and in the realm! / With the autonomous rule of Prajāpati Parameṣṭhin I sprinkle you,” he says. / To autonomous rule indeed he leads him.

2.7.7.s: siṃhe vyāghra uta yā pṛdākau | tviṣiragnau brāhmaṇe sūrye yā | indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna | sā na āganvarcasā saṃvidānā | yā rājanye dundubhāvāyatāyām | aśvasya krandye puruṣasya māyau | indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna | sā na āganvarcasā saṃvidānā | yā hastini dvīpini yā hiraṇye | tviṣiraśveṣu puruṣeṣu goṣu
2.7.7.d: सिंहे व्याघ्र उत या पृदाकौ । त्विषिरग्नौ ब्राह्मणे सूर्ये या । इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान । सा न आगन्वर्चसा संविदाना । या राजन्ये दुन्दुभावायतायाम् । अश्वस्य क्रन्द्ये पुरुषस्य मायौ । इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान । सा न आगन्वर्चसा संविदाना । या हस्तिनि द्वीपिनि या हिरण्ये । त्विषिरश्वेषु पुरुषेषु गोषु
2.7.7.m:
The brilliance that is in the lion, in the tiger, and in the viper, / the fiery energy in fire, in the Brahmin, in the sun, / the divine, fortunate goddess who gave birth to Indra— / may she come to us, agreeing, with luster! / That which is in the Rājanya, in the drum, in the drawn [bow], / in the whinny of the horse, in the roar of man, / the divine, fortunate goddess who gave birth to Indra— / may she come to us, agreeing, with luster! / That which is in the elephant, in the panther, that which is in gold, / the brilliance in horses, in men, in cows,

the divine, fortunate goddess who gave birth to Indra— / may she come to us, agreeing, with luster! / In the chariot, in the dice, in the bull's vigor, / in the wind, in Parjanya, in Varuṇa's fury, / the divine, fortunate goddess who gave birth to Indra— / may she come to us, agreeing, with luster! / You are king, you are sovereign ruler, / you are emperor, you are autonomous ruler. / For Indra full of fiery energy, I mix you full of fiery energy. / For Indra full of splendorous might, I mix you full of splendorous might.

2.7.7.s: indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna | sā na āganvarcasā saṃvidānā | rathe akṣeṣu vṛṣabhasya vāje | vāte parjanye varuṇasya śuṣme | indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna | sā na āganvarcasā saṃvidānā | rāḍasi virāḍasi | samrāḍasi svarāḍasi | indrāya tvā tejasvate tejasvantaṃ śrīṇāmi | indrāya tvaujasvata ojasvantaṃ śrīṇāmi
2.7.7.d: इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान । सा न आगन्वर्चसा संविदाना । रथे अक्षेषु वृषभस्य वाजे । वाते पर्जन्ये वरुणस्य शुष्मे । इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान । सा न आगन्वर्चसा संविदाना । राडसि विराडसि । सम्राडसि स्वराडसि । इन्द्राय त्वा तेजस्वते तेजस्वन्तं श्रीणामि । इन्द्राय त्वौजस्वत ओजस्वन्तं श्रीणामि

2.7.7.s: indrāya tvā payasvate payasvantaṃ śrīṇāmi | indrāya tvā''yuṣmata āyuṣmantaṃ śrīṇāmi | tejo'si | tatte prayacchāmi | tejasvadastu me mukham | tejasvacchiro astu me | tejasvān viśvataḥ pratyaṅ | tejasā saṃpipṛgdhi mā | ojo'si | tatte prayacchāmi
2.7.7.d: इन्द्राय त्वा पयस्वते पयस्वन्तं श्रीणामि । इन्द्राय त्वा'ऽयुष्मत आयुष्मन्तं श्रीणामि । तेजोऽसि । तत्ते प्रयच्छामि । तेजस्वदस्तु मे मुखम् । तेजस्वच्छिरो अस्तु मे । तेजस्वान् विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । तेजसा संपिपृग्धि मा । ओजोऽसि । तत्ते प्रयच्छामि
2.7.7.m: For Indra full of milk, I mix you full of milk. / For Indra endowed with a lifespan, I mix you endowed with a lifespan. / “You are fiery energy; / that I bestow on you. / Fiery may my face be; / fiery may my head be; / fiery facing in all directions. / Unite me with fiery energy!” / “You are splendorous might; / that I bestow on you.

2.7.7.s: ojasvadastu me mukham | ojasvacchiro astu me | ojasvān viśvataḥ pratyaṅ | ojasā saṃpipṛgdhi mā | payo'si | tatte prayacchāmi | payasvadastu me mukham | payasvacchiro astu me | payasvān viśvataḥ pratyaṅ | payasā saṃpipṛgdhi mā
2.7.7.d: ओजस्वदस्तु मे मुखम् । ओजस्वच्छिरो अस्तु मे । ओजस्वान् विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । ओजसा संपिपृग्धि मा । पयोऽसि । तत्ते प्रयच्छामि । पयस्वदस्तु मे मुखम् । पयस्वच्छिरो अस्तु मे । पयस्वान् विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । पयसा संपिपृग्धि मा
2.7.7.m: Might-filled may my face be; / might-filled may my head be; / might-filled facing in all directions. / Unite me with splendorous might!” / “You are milk; / that I bestow on you. / Full of milk may my face be; / full of milk may my head be; / full of milk facing in all directions. / Unite me with milk!”

2.7.7.s: āyurasi | tatte prayacchāmi | āyuṣmadastu me mukham | āyuṣmacchiro astu me | āyuṣmān viśvataḥ pratyaṅ | āyuṣā saṃpipṛgdhi mā | imamagna āyuṣe varcase kṛdhi | priyaṃ reto varuṇa soma rājan | mātevāsmā adite śarma yaccha | viśve devā jaradaṣṭiryathā sat
2.7.7.d: आयुरसि । तत्ते प्रयच्छामि । आयुष्मदस्तु मे मुखम् । आयुष्मच्छिरो अस्तु मे । आयुष्मान् विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । आयुषा संपिपृग्धि मा । इममग्न आयुषे वर्चसे कृधि । प्रियं रेतो वरुण सोम राजन् । मातेवास्मा अदिते शर्म यच्छ । विश्वे देवा जरदष्टिर्यथा सत्
2.7.7.m: “You are lifespan; / that I bestow on you. / Endowed with a lifespan may my face be; / endowed with a lifespan may my head be; endowed with a lifespan facing in all directions. / Unite me with lifespan!” / “Make this man, O Agni, [ready] for lifespan, for luster, / a dear seed, O Varuṇa, O king Soma; / like a mother, O Aditi, grant him protection, / O All-gods, so that he may reach old age!”

2.7.7.s: āyurasi viśvāyurasi | sarvāyurasi sarvamāyurasi | yato vāto manojavāḥ | yataḥ kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | tāsāṃ tvā sarvāsāṃ rucā | abhiṣiñcāmi varcasā | samudra ivāsi gahmanā | soma ivāsyadābhyaḥ | agniriva viśvataḥ pratyaṅ | sūrya iva jyotiṣā vibhūḥ
2.7.7.d: आयुरसि विश्वायुरसि । सर्वायुरसि सर्वमायुरसि । यतो वातो मनोजवाः । यतः क्षरन्ति सिन्धवः । तासां त्वा सर्वासां रुचा । अभिषिञ्चामि वर्चसा । समुद्र इवासि गह्मना । सोम इवास्यदाभ्यः । अग्निरिव विश्वतः प्रत्यङ् । सूर्य इव ज्योतिषा विभूः
2.7.7.m: “You are lifespan, you are all lifespan, / you are the complete lifespan, you are entire lifespan.” / “From where the wind swift as thought blows, / whence the rivers flow, / with the brilliance of all of them, / with luster I sprinkle you.” / “Like the ocean are you in depth; / like Soma are you unassailable; / like Agni facing in all directions; / like the sun pervading with light.”

2.7.7.s: apāṃ yo dravaṇe rasaḥ | tamahamasmā āmuṣyāyaṇāya | tejase brahmavarcasāya gṛhṇāmi | apāṃ ya ūrmau rasaḥ | tamahamasmā āmuṣyāyaṇāya | ojase vīryāya gṛhṇāmi | apāṃ yo madhyato rasaḥ | tamahamasmā āmuṣyāyaṇāya | puṣṭyai prajananāya gṛhṇāmi | apāṃ yo yajñiyo rasaḥ | tamahamasmā āmuṣyāyaṇāya | āyuṣe dīrghāyutvāya gṛhṇāmi
2.7.7.d: अपां यो द्रवणे रसः । तमहमस्मा आमुष्यायणाय । तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसाय गृह्णामि । अपां य ऊर्मौ रसः । तमहमस्मा आमुष्यायणाय । ओजसे वीर्याय गृह्णामि । अपां यो मध्यतो रसः । तमहमस्मा आमुष्यायणाय । पुष्ट्यै प्रजननाय गृह्णामि । अपां यो यज्ञियो रसः । तमहमस्मा आमुष्यायणाय । आयुषे दीर्घायुत्वाय गृह्णामि
2.7.7.m: “The essence of the waters which is in their flowing, / that do I draw for this descendant of so-and-so, / for fiery energy, for spiritual preeminence. / The essence of the waters which is in the wave, / that do I draw for this descendant of so-and-so, / for splendorous might, for heroic power. / The essence of the waters which is in the middle, / that do I draw for this descendant of so-and-so, / for nourishment, for procreation. / The essence of the waters which is fit for sacrifice, / that do I draw for this descendant of so-and-so, / for lifespan, for long life.”

2.7.8.s: abhiprehi vīrayasva | ugraścettā sapatnahā | ātiṣṭha mitravardhanaḥ | tubhyaṃ devā adhibravan | aṅkau nyaṅkāvabhita ātiṣṭha vṛtrahanratham | ātiṣṭhantaṃ pari viśve abhūṣan | śriyaṃ vasānaścarati svarocāḥ | mahattadasyāsurasya nāma | ā viśvarūpo amṛtāni tasthau | anu tvendro madatvanu bṛhaspatiḥ
2.7.8.d: अभिप्रेहि वीरयस्व । उग्रश्चेत्ता सपत्नहा । आतिष्ठ मित्रवर्धनः । तुभ्यं देवा अधिब्रवन् । अङ्कौ न्यङ्कावभित आतिष्ठ वृत्रहन्रथम् । आतिष्ठन्तं परि विश्वे अभूषन् । श्रियं वसानश्चरति स्वरोचाः । महत्तदस्यासुरस्य नाम । आ विश्वरूपो अमृतानि तस्थौ । अनु त्वेन्द्रो मदत्वनु बृहस्पतिः
2.7.8.m: “Step forth, show your heroism, / fierce avenger, slayer of rivals! / Mount [the chariot], advancer of friends; / on your behalf the gods have spoken.” / Mount the chariot on its curved parts, O slayer of Vṛtra! / Around him mounting, all [creatures] adorned themselves; / clothed in splendor, self-luminous he moves; / great is that name of this Asura; / of manifold form, he has mounted the immortals. / May Indra delight after you, may Bṛhaspati,

2.7.8.s: anu somo anvagnirāvīt | anu tvā viśve devā avantu | anu sapta rājāno ya utābhiṣiktāḥ | anu tvā mitrāvaruṇāvihāvatam | anudyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśaṃbhū | sūryo ahobhiranu tvā'vatu | candramā nakṣatrairanu tvā'vatu | dyauśca tvā pṛthivī ca pracetasā | śukro bṛhaddakṣiṇā tvā pipartu | anu svadhā cikitāṃ somo agniḥ | ā'yaṃ pṛṇaktu rajasī upastham
2.7.8.d: अनु सोमो अन्वग्निरावीत् । अनु त्वा विश्वे देवा अवन्तु । अनु सप्त राजानो य उताभिषिक्ताः । अनु त्वा मित्रावरुणाविहावतम् । अनुद्यावापृथिवी विश्वशंभू । सूर्यो अहोभिरनु त्वाऽवतु । चन्द्रमा नक्षत्रैरनु त्वाऽवतु । द्यौश्च त्वा पृथिवी च प्रचेतसा । शुक्रो बृहद्दक्षिणा त्वा पिपर्तु । अनु स्वधा चिकितां सोमो अग्निः । आऽयं पृणक्तु रजसी उपस्थम्
2.7.8.m: may Soma, may Agni have protected [you]! / May the All-gods help you, / and the seven kings who have also been consecrated. / May Mitra and Varuṇa help you here, / and heaven and earth that bring welfare to all. / May the sun help you with the days; / may the moon help you with the lunar mansions. / May heaven and earth, wise ones, / may the clear soma cup and the lofty sacrificial gift protect you! / Attentive to the ancestral oblation, may Soma and Agni, / may this one fill both realms and the lap!”

2.7.9.s: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tā asmāthsṛṣṭāḥ parācīrāyan | sa etaṃ prajāpatirodanamapaśyat | so'nnaṃ bhūto'tiṣṭhat | tā anyatrānnādyamavittvā | prajāpatiṃ prajā upāvartanta | annamevainaṃ bhūtaṃ paśyantīḥ prajā upāvartante | ya etena yajate | ya u cainamevaṃ veda | sarvāṇyannāni bhavanti
2.7.9.d: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । ता अस्माथ्सृष्टाः पराचीरायन् । स एतं प्रजापतिरोदनमपश्यत् । सोऽन्नं भूतोऽतिष्ठत् । ता अन्यत्रान्नाद्यमवित्त्वा । प्रजापतिं प्रजा उपावर्तन्त । अन्नमेवैनं भूतं पश्यन्तीः प्रजा उपावर्तन्ते । य एतेन यजते । य उ चैनमेवं वेद । सर्वाण्यन्नानि भवन्ति
2.7.9.m: Prajāpati created offspring. / Having been created, they went away from him. / Prajāpati saw this boiled rice mess. / Having become food, he stood. / They, having found no food elsewhere, / the offspring returned to Prajāpati. / Seeing him having become food, offspring return to him / who sacrifices with this, / and who knows it thus. / All foods become his.

2.7.9.s: sarve puruṣāḥ | sarvāṇyevānnānyavarundhe | sarvānpuruṣān | rāḍasi virāḍasītyāha | svārājyamevainaṃ gamayati | yaddhiraṇyaṃ dadāti | tejastenāvarundhe | yattisṛdhanvam | vīryaṃ tena | yadaṣṭrām
2.7.9.d: सर्वे पुरुषाः । सर्वाण्येवान्नान्यवरुन्धे । सर्वान्पुरुषान् । राडसि विराडसीत्याह । स्वाराज्यमेवैनं गमयति । यद्धिरण्यं ददाति । तेजस्तेनावरुन्धे । यत्तिसृधन्वम् । वीर्यं तेन । यदष्ट्राम्
