2.8.5.d: प्रपथे दिवः प्रपथे पृथिव्याः । उभे अभि प्रियतमे सधस्थे । आ च परा च चरति प्रजानन् । पूषा सुबन्धुर्दिव आपृथिव्याः । इडस्पतिर्मघवा दस्मवर्चाः । तं देवासो अददुः सूर्यायै । कामेन कृतं तवसं स्वञ्चम् । अजाश्वः पशुपा वाजबस्त्यः । धियंजिन्वो विश्वे भुवने अर्पितः । अष्ट्रां पूषा शिथिरामुद्वरीवृजत्
2.8.5.m: On the distant pathway of heaven, on the distant pathway of earth; / towards both most beloved dwelling-places / he travels to and fro, knowing well: / Pūṣan, the good kinsman of heaven and earth, / the lord of nourishment, the bounteous one of wondrous radiance. / Him the gods gave to Sūryā, / made according to desire, strong, moving well, / with goats for horses, guardian of livestock, rich in booty, / quickening thought, placed in every creature: / Pūṣan brandishes his loose goad.

2.8.5.s: saṃcakṣāṇo bhuvanā deva īyate | śucī vo havyā marutaḥ śucīnām | śuciṃ hinomyadhvaraṃ śucibhyaḥ | ṛtena satyamṛtasāpa āyan | śucijanmānaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ | pra citramarkaṃ gṛṇate turāya | mārutāya svatavase bharadhvam | ye sahāṃsi sahasā sahante | rejate agne pṛthivī makhebhyaḥ | aṃseṣvā marutaḥ khādayo vaḥ
2.8.5.d: संचक्षाणो भुवना देव ईयते । शुची वो हव्या मरुतः शुचीनाम् । शुचिं हिनोम्यध्वरं शुचिभ्यः । ऋतेन सत्यमृतसाप आयन् । शुचिजन्मानः शुचयः पावकाः । प्र चित्रमर्कं गृणते तुराय । मारुताय स्वतवसे भरध्वम् । ये सहांसि सहसा सहन्ते । रेजते अग्ने पृथिवी मखेभ्यः । अंसेष्वा मरुतः खादयो वः
2.8.5.m: Beholding all creatures, the god moves. / Pure are your oblations, O Maruts, of the pure ones; / I send a pure sacrificial rite to the pure ones. / Through truth they attained the true, they who attend to truth, / of pure origin, pure, purifying. / Bring forth a bright song for the swift Marut host, / self-strong, which sings forth! / They who overcome powers with power, / the earth trembles, O Agni, before the vigorous ones. / On your shoulders, O Maruts, are the rings;

2.8.5.s: vakṣassu rukmā upaśiśriyāṇāḥ | vi vidyuto na vṛṣṭibhī rucānāḥ | anu svadhāmāyudhairyacchamānāḥ | yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi | tridhātūni dāśuṣe yacchatādhi | asmabhyaṃ tāni maruto viyanta | rayiṃ no dhatta vṛṣaṇaḥ suvīram | ime turaṃ maruto rāmayanti | ime sahaḥ sahasa ānamanti | ime śaṃsaṃ vanuṣyato nipānti
2.8.5.d: वक्षस्सु रुक्मा उपशिश्रियाणाः । वि विद्युतो न वृष्टिभी रुचानाः । अनु स्वधामायुधैर्यच्छमानाः । या वः शर्म शशमानाय सन्ति । त्रिधातूनि दाशुषे यच्छताधि । अस्मभ्यं तानि मरुतो वियन्त । रयिं नो धत्त वृषणः सुवीरम् । इमे तुरं मरुतो रामयन्ति । इमे सहः सहस आनमन्ति । इमे शंसं वनुष्यतो निपान्ति
2.8.5.m: on your chests are golden breastplates resting, / gleaming like lightnings through the downpours of rain, / striving according to their custom with weapons! / What protections of yours exist for him who strives, / threefold, bestow them upon the worshipper! / Extend these to us, O Maruts; / bestow on us wealth rich in good heroes, O bulls! / These Maruts bring the impetuous to rest; / these bend power with their power; / these protect the prayer from the assailant.

2.8.5.s: gurudveṣo araruṣe dadhanti | arā ivedacaramā aheva | pra prajāyante akavā mahobhiḥ | pṛśneḥ putrā upamāso rabhiṣṭhāḥ | svayā matyā marutaḥ saṃmimikṣuḥ | anu te dāyi maha indriyāya | satrā te viśvamanu vṛtrahatye | anu kṣattramanu saho yajatra | indra devebhiranu te nṛṣahye | ya indra śuṣmo maghavante asti
2.8.5.d: गुरुद्वेषो अररुषे दधन्ति । अरा इवेदचरमा अहेव । प्र प्रजायन्ते अकवा महोभिः । पृश्नेः पुत्रा उपमासो रभिष्ठाः । स्वया मत्या मरुतः संमिमिक्षुः । अनु ते दायि मह इन्द्रियाय । सत्रा ते विश्वमनु वृत्रहत्ये । अनु क्षत्त्रमनु सहो यजत्र । इन्द्र देवेभिरनु ते नृषह्ये । य इन्द्र शुष्मो मघवन्ते अस्ति
2.8.5.m: They place heavy hatred upon the ungenerous one. / Like spokes, not behindhand, like days, / they multiply, not insignificant in their great deeds. / The sons of Pṛśni, the supreme, the most vehement, / by their own thought the Maruts have united. / For your great Indra-power was it conceded; / completely was everything conceded to you in the slaying of Vṛtra, / conceded was regal power, conceded was might, O worshipful one; / O Indra, with the gods, conceded to you was victory over men. / What vigor is yours, O Indra, O bounteous one—

2.8.5.s: śikṣā sakhibhyaḥ puruhūta nṛbhyaḥ | tvaṃ hi dṛḍhā maghavanvicetāḥ | apāvṛdhi parivṛtiṃ na rādhaḥ | indro rājā jagataścarṣaṇīnām | adhikṣami viṣurūpaṃ yadasti | tato dadātu dāśuṣe vasūni | codadrādha upastutaścidarvāk | tamu ṣṭuhi yo abhibhūtyojāḥ | vanvannavātaḥ puruhūta indraḥ | aṣāḍhamugraṃ sahamānamābhiḥ |
2.8.5.d: शिक्षा सखिभ्यः पुरुहूत नृभ्यः । त्वं हि दृढा मघवन्विचेताः । अपावृधि परिवृतिं न राधः । इन्द्रो राजा जगतश्चर्षणीनाम् । अधिक्षमि विषुरूपं यदस्ति । ततो ददातु दाशुषे वसूनि । चोदद्राध उपस्तुतश्चिदर्वाक् । तमु ष्टुहि यो अभिभूत्योजाः । वन्वन्नवातः पुरुहूत इन्द्रः । अषाढमुग्रं सहमानमाभिः ।
2.8.5.m: Give generously to your friends, to the men, O much-invoked one! / For you, O bounteous one, are wise [and open] the strongholds. / Uncover the treasure like an enclosure! / Indra is king of the moving world, of the peoples, / of whatever of varied form is upon the earth. / From that let him give riches to the worshiper; / praised, let him impel treasure toward us. / Praise him, whose might is overpowering, / who wins without being assailed, Indra, the much-invoked! / With these songs exalt the unconquerable, the fierce, the conquering bull of the peoples! / He who rules over solid, great wealth, / that Indra let us praise in the assemblies! / He who with Vāyu wins in the contests for cattle, / leads boldly toward greater wealth. / Let your bull-like fury come from behind, / from the north, from below, from the front! / Let it converge from every side toward us! / O Indra, place luminous wealth in us!

2.8.5.s: gīrbhirvardha vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām | sthūrasya rāyo bṛhato ya īśe | tamu ṣṭavāma vidatheṣvindram | yo vāyunā jayati gomatīṣu | pra dhṛṣṇuyā nayati vasyo accha | ā te śuṣmo vṛṣabha etu paścāt | ottarādadharāgā purastāt | ā viśvato abhi sametvarvāṅ | indra dyumnaṃ suvarvaddhehyasme
2.8.5.d: गीर्भिर्वर्ध वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् । स्थूरस्य रायो बृहतो य ईशे । तमु ष्टवाम विदथेष्विन्द्रम् । यो वायुना जयति गोमतीषु । प्र धृष्णुया नयति वस्यो अच्छ । आ ते शुष्मो वृषभ एतु पश्चात् । ओत्तरादधरागा पुरस्तात् । आ विश्वतो अभि समेत्वर्वाङ् । इन्द्र द्युम्नं सुवर्वद्धेह्यस्मे
